body.en: Democratic Senate candidate for Michigan distances himself from Twitch streamer and debates Fox News host The Democratic candidate for Senate in the swing state of Michigan has spent the week trying to keep his affordability message front and center as scrutiny mounts from both ends of the political spectrum. In the span of two days, Abdul El-Sayed distanced himself from leftwing streamer Hasan Piker, spoke out against rightwing hate directed at the Muslim community, and debated Fox News host Jesse Watters on taxing billionaires. The clip circulating most from the Fox interview, though, focused on circumcision - specifically, El-Sayed asking Watters whether he circumcised, in a retort to Watters’ question about gender-affirming care. body.en: Follow updates live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Angela Jackson, the commissioner of the Productivity Commission, said the body stands by the interim report into the GST, which found the deal with Western Australia to be a costly mistake that should be reversed. Jackson spoke to RN this morning after WA premier Roger Cook said “east coast clowns” didn’t understand the state and any changes would “rip $6bn out of the Western Australia economy”. We are aiming, of course, to inform public policy debate, which can often get heated. Our view is that a line was crossed in terms of the nature of those comments from the Western Australian premier last month. We welcome debate and we welcome criticism of our work and our report more broadly because it makes our work stronger. But to undermine and I guess attack our integrity, I think is an additional bridge too far. And I think something that more broadly we are seeing in public debate internationally. It’s important for us to indicate that that process will not be influenced by the prime minister’s comments, that we are above politics, and that’s a very important position that we hold within the public policy landscape in Australia. title.en: The Queen of Country: Dolly Parton's life in pictures
title.zh: 乡村女王：多莉·帕顿的照片中的生活

summary.en: Parton is remembered by fans as a singular songwriting talent, a prolific artist, and shrewd, trailblazing businesswoman.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Dolly Parton, the country music star who rose from grinding poverty in Tennessee to become a rhinestone-studded cultural icon with hits like Jolene and 9 to 5, has died at 80, her family said on Wednesday .

Dolly Rebecca Parton was born on 19 January 1946 in Sevierville, Tennessee, the fourth of 12 children who grew up dirt-poor in the family's small shack in the Great Smoky Mountains.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Parton was more than a singer — she wrote 3,000 songs, acted in major Hollywood films and donated millions of dollars to charities in her home state and beyond.

She was also an accomplished businesswoman, with her interests spanning from her popular Dollywood theme park to cosmetics, pet apparel, baking mixes and even a truck stop.

During a prolific career that spanned six decades, Parton penned hits such as Jolene, Coat of Many Colours and the iconic ballad I Will Always Love You, which became an international success for Whitney Houston.

Never one to downplay her striking looks, Parton essentially wrote the book on how a woman can rule the airwaves in a male-dominated industry, with songs covered by everyone from Shania Twain to Sinead O'Connor.

The US singer-songwriter, actress, businesswoman and philanthropist didn't seem to mind being mistaken for a ditzy blonde all too eager to play up her looks, after growing up poor in rural Tennessee.

At the height of her fame, she reached number one on the pop charts, with songs like Islands in the Stream, and starred in Hollywood blockbusters 9 to 5, for which she sang the insuppressible title track, and Steel Magnolias.

Parton initially turned down the honour, saying she felt she hadn't earned it. She released a rock album, Rockstar, in 2023, which she called an attempt to justify the induction.

Affording her the sort of honour given to major state figures, US President Donald Trump ordered flags across the country to be lowered for a week to mark what he called a "true loss for millions of people".

body.zh: 乡村音乐明星多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 去世，享年 80 岁。多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 的家人周三表示，她从田纳西州的极度贫困中脱身，凭借《乔琳 (Jolene)》和《朝九晚五》(9 to 5) 等热门歌曲成为镶满莱茵石的文化偶像。多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 去世，享年 80 岁。 多莉·丽贝卡·帕顿 (Dolly Rebecca Parton) 1946 年 1 月 19 日出生于田纳西州塞维尔维尔，在 12 个孩子中排行第四，她在大烟山的家庭小棚屋里长大，一贫如洗。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 帕顿不仅仅是一名歌手，她创作了 3,000 首歌曲，出演过好莱坞主要电影，并向家乡及其他地区的慈善机构捐赠了数百万美元。 她也是一位颇有成就的女商人，兴趣广泛，从广受欢迎的多莱坞主题公园到化妆品、宠物服装、烘焙混合物，甚至卡车停靠站。 在长达六十年多产的职业生涯中，帕顿创作了《乔琳》、《多色外套》等热门歌曲，以及惠特尼·休斯顿在国际上取得成功的标志性民谣《我将永远爱你》。 帕顿从不低估她引人注目的外表，她写的这本书本质上是关于女性如何在男性主导的行业中统治电视广播，从仙妮亚·唐恩到西尼德·奥康纳等所有人都翻唱过她的歌曲。 这位美国歌手兼作曲家、演员、女商人和慈善家似乎并不介意被误认为是一个痴迷的金发女郎，她在田纳西州的贫困乡村长大，过于渴望展示自己的外表。 在她名气的鼎盛时期，她凭借《Islands in the Stream》等歌曲在流行音乐排行榜上名列第一，并主演了好莱坞大片《朝九晚五》，其中她演唱了令人难以抑制的主打歌《Steel Magnolias》和《Steel Magnolias》。 帕顿最初拒绝了这一荣誉，称她觉得自己没有赢得这个荣誉。她于 2023 年发行了一张摇滚专辑《Rockstar》，她称这是一次证明入职合理性的尝试。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向她提供了给予主要国家人物的荣誉，下令全国降旗一周，以纪念他所说的“数百万人的真正损失”。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: Trump threatens to rename Lake Ontario as Canada hits back at US tariffs
title.zh: 加拿大反击美国关税，特朗普威胁要重新命名安大略湖

summary.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada won't be subordinated as 50 per cent US tariffs trigger a CAD $5.4B (AU $5.4B) aid package.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
President Donald Trump is considering changing the name of Lake Ontario to "Lake America" as the trade war between the United States and Canada intensifies.

"The United States is giving serious consideration to changing the name of Lake Ontario to Lake America in that we don't expect to doing much business with Ontario any longer," Trump wrote on social media. Ontario is Canada's most populous province and is home to the country's auto industry.

The threat is reminiscent of the Republican president's unilateral action in 2025 by executive order to rename the Gulf of Mexico the Gulf of America.

The combative rhetoric between the two countries has escalated, with Trump telling Canadian leaders Tuesday to "fall in line" or face consequences "far WORSE" than existing tariffs.

He also threatened new 50 per cent tariffs on Canadian vehicles, vehicle parts and steel, while Prime Minister Mark Carney said US trade demands showed that Washington wanted to "destroy our major industries," including vehicle manufacture, steel and aluminium.

On Wednesday, Canada announced counter-tariffs on US goods, ranging between 15 and 50 per cent, intensifying the trade war between the historically close allies.

Ottawa's retaliation will take effect on 8 September, a timeframe that Carney had earlier outlined after Trump's 50 per cent duties came into effect on Sunday.

The steep US tariffs hit approximately US $20 billion (AU $28B) in Canadian goods — about 5.5 per cent of its US exports — after trade negotiations collapsed at the eleventh hour. A wide range of sectors including wine, furniture, dairy products, cement, clothing, fishing rods, and hockey equipment are affected.

"Canada will match Washington's new tariffs dollar for dollar in order to protect Canadian workers, farmers, families, and businesses," Carney said at a news conference. "We cannot accept what they have offered, and we will not give what they have asked."

Under Canada's planned response, US steel and aluminium products previously subject to a 25 per cent duty will soon face 50 per cent tariffs. Goods facing 25 per cent tariffs include appliances, dairy products like cheese, as well as certain steel and aluminium derivative products. Overall, these formed about 7.3 per cent of Canada's imports from the US in 2024.

Canada's government also announced a CAD $5.4 billion (AU $5.4B) aid package for impacted firms and workers.

title.en: Dolly Parton, music legend, actor, and philanthropist, dies at 80
title.zh: 音乐传奇人物、演员和慈善家多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 去世，享年 80 岁

summary.en: The prolific songwriter, known as the Queen of Country, released 49 studio albums and hundreds of songs across a 60-year career.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Dolly Parton, the country music icon whose soaring vibrato vocals, poignant songwriting and sparkling costumes defined her rise from a log cabin in the Tennessee mountains to the height of stardom and acclaim, has died. She was 80 years old.

Parton died peacefully in Nashville, Tennessee, her publicist said in a statement released on Wednesday AEST.

Known for her curvy physique, massive blonde wigs and skin-tight outfits that served her self-deprecating wit, she was among the most beloved personalities in music and beyond — the rare celebrity whose appeal transcended generations, geography and politics.

She wrote hundreds of songs, including classics like Jolene, Coat of Many Colours and I Will Always Love You, that totalled more than 100 million worldwide sales and more than one billion online streams.

Parton, who plucked bejewelled banjos, guitars and dulcimers with her long fingernails during performances, was a generous philanthropist and successful businesswoman whose projects included a theme park in the Smoky Mountain foothills near her birthplace.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Her career was forever influenced by her upbringing as one of 12 children born into what she called a "dirt poor" Tennessee family. She started her education nonprofit, Imagination Library, to send free books to children in Tennessee because her father, who quit school to work on the farm, struggled to learn to read.

Parton's first musical performances were in church, where her grandfather was a preacher. By age 10, she was learning guitar and singing on local television shows. At 13, she appeared on the Grand Ole Opry in Nashville, where Johnny Cash introduced her as "a little girl here from up in East Tennessee".

With a suitcase of songs, she followed her uncle, Bill Owens, also a songwriter, to Nashville after graduating high school in 1964.

Fred Foster, who produced Roy Orbison, Willie Nelson and more, saw her potential and got her songs cut by other artists, as well as recording and releasing Parton singing her own material. By the mid-1970s, Parton was a Nashville queen.

Parton's partnership with Porter Wagoner, a pencil-thin pompadoured star with flashy rhinestone outfits, was key to her career. She honed her acting skills on his syndicated TV show, and he advocated for her to get a record deal at RCA. Their first duet, The Last Thing on My Mind, was released in 1967, the same year she started her own publishing company.

While their duets were often big radio hits, Parton's solo singles didn't chart as high at first. With Wagoner as a co-producer, she began to adjust her country warble to a more polished, pop-leaning style.

title.en: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
title.zh: 加拿大宣布对美国征收高达50%的“美元对美元”报复性关税

summary.en: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Canada has announced counter-tariffs as high as 50% on a range of US goods in retaliation to the latest wave of levies on Canadian imports imposed by President Donald Trump last weekend.

The Canadian tariffs will apply to nearly C$28bn ($20bn; £15bn) worth of American products, ranging from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and cotton T-shirts, officials announced on Tuesday.

The list of targeted products is designed to match Canadian goods hit by the US. The Canadian levies are set to come into effect on 8 September.

It is the latest escalation after US-Canada trade talks collapsed late last week, with each side accusing the other of making last-minute demands that were unreasonable.

Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne said that Canada's retaliation is in response to 50% tariffs imposed by the Trump administration on a range of Canadian goods after trade talks fell apart on Friday.

"Those tariffs will have real consequences for Canadian workers, businesses and communities across our nation," he said. "Canada must respond."

Champagne characterised Canada's retaliation as "proportionate" and "strategic".

He added that Canada will also offer businesses and workers impacted by US tariffs an additional C$7.5bn for support programmes designed to minimise job losses and keep companies afloat.

Placing taxes on trade between what are historically two of the world's closest trading partners will undoubtedly lead to pain on both sides of the border.

Supply chains which have been developed over decades are set to see increased trading costs due the latest tariff announcements made from both the US and Canada, ultimately hitting businesses of all sizes and consumers through potentially higher prices.

Polls suggest the majority of Canadians support their government in holding firm against the US.

But some questions remain on exactly why trade talks fell apart, with the Conservative opposition asking that the full text of the draft deal with the US be released.

Businesses have also expressed concerns about the impact of a prolonged trade war with Canada's largest trading partner.

The White House released a statement after Canada announced its counter-tariffs, saying that the US was prepared to offer Canada "the most preferential market access of any country on Earth" in recent trade talks.

"Instead of partnership, Canada chose unreasonable demands, walk-backs, and flat-out rejection," it said.

In a series of Tuesday posts on Truth Social, Trump also accused Canada of "ripping off" the US for decades and of charging American farmers steep tariffs.

"I deal with many countries, and Canada is easily the most difficult and unreasonable," Trump wrote. "They feel entitled, but they are not a State, and will be entitled no longer!"

title.en: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
title.zh: 美国媒体报道称，中情局局长在莫斯科进行未公开的会谈

summary.en: Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday. US media reports indicate the head of the CIA visited Moscow for unannounced talks.
summary.zh: 飞行跟踪数据显示，周二有一架美国军用飞机经拉脱维亚从美国飞往俄罗斯。美国媒体报道称，中央情报局局长前往莫斯科进行了未公开的会谈。

body.en:
The head of the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) has travelled to Moscow for unannounced talks, the BBC's US news partner CBS has reported.

John Ratcliffe reportedly arrived in the Russian capital earlier on Tuesday. Neither Washington or Moscow have confirmed the nature of the visit or who he was due to meet.

Flight tracking data confirmed a large US military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday. It departed later on Tuesday.

Footage posted on social media showed the C-17 transport plane approaching Moscow's Vnukovo international airport.

It departed Riga airport at 05:50 GMT and appeared to have landed in the Russian capital at around 07:04 GMT, according to data from FlightRadar24. It returned to Riga shortly before 17:00 GMT.

Footage on social media also purported to show a diplomatic motorcade travelling through Moscow.

Ahead of the trip, the US told Ukraine that a senior delegation would be travelling to Moscow and asked Kyiv to suspend strikes until they had left, a senior Ukrainian official told CBS.

The trip is thought to be Ratcliffe's first trip to Russia as CIA director, although he has maintained contact with his intelligence counterparts in Moscow.

John Foreman, who served as a British military attaché to Moscow between 2019 and 2022, told Radio 4's PM programme that the visit could be focused on "escalation management" given speculation recent drone activity in Germany could be linked to Russia .

He said: "The Americans don't normally send such a high ranking official to Moscow unannounced at short notice unless something is up."

Foreman said the trip could also concern the release of US detainees currently being held in Russia.

Ratcliffe played a role in negotiations for the release of Russian-American citizen Ksenia Karelina, who was jailed in Russia for over a year after being accused of providing support to Ukraine.

The CIA was also involved in a 2024 prisoner swap deal with Russia that saw the release of Wall Street Journal reporter Evan Gershkovich, as well as former US marine Paul Whelan and Russian-American journalist Alsu Kurmasheva.

The US has had strained relations with Russia since it launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Since then, Russia has been isolated on the world stage and faced international economic sanctions.

Ratcliffe appears to be one of the highest-ranking US officials to visit the country during President Donald Trump's second term.

Trump met Russian President Vladimir Putin at a summit in Alaska last year but the meeting did not lead to a breakthrough. Subsequent US-led peace talks between Russia and Ukraine appear to have stalled.
body.zh: 据英国广播公司（BBC）美国新闻合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）报道，美国中央情报局（CIA）局长前往莫斯科进行未经宣布的会谈。 据报道，约翰·拉特克利夫于周二早些时候抵达俄罗斯首都。华盛顿和莫斯科都没有证实这次访问的性质或他将与谁会面。 飞行跟踪数据证实，一架大型美国军用飞机周二从美国经拉脱维亚飞往俄罗斯。该航班于周二晚些时候出发。 社交媒体上发布的视频显示，这架C-17运输机正在接近莫斯科伏努科沃国际机场。 根据 FlightRadar24 的数据，这架飞机于格林威治标准时间 05:50 离开里加机场，并于格林威治标准时间 07:04 左右降落在俄罗斯首都。它于格林尼治标准时间 16:00 之前不久离开莫斯科。 社交媒体上的视频也据称显示外交车队穿越莫斯科。 这次旅行被认为是拉特克利夫作为中央情报局局长首次访问俄罗斯，尽管他一直与莫斯科的情报同行保持联系。 他在释放俄裔美国公民克塞尼亚·卡列利娜的谈判中发挥了作用，卡列利娜因被指控向乌克兰提供支持而在俄罗斯被监禁一年多。 中央情报局还参与了 2024 年与俄罗斯的囚犯交换协议，该协议释放了《华尔街日报》记者埃文·格什科维奇、前美国海军陆战队员保罗·惠兰和俄裔美国记者阿尔苏·库尔马舍娃。 自2022年全面入侵乌克兰以来，美国与俄罗斯的关系一直紧张。此后，俄罗斯在世界舞台上被孤立，并面临国际经济制裁。 拉特克利夫似乎是唐纳德·特朗普总统第二任期内访问该国的最高级别的美国官员之一。 特朗普去年在阿拉斯加峰会上会见了俄罗斯总统普京，但会议并未取得突破。随后美国主导的俄罗斯和乌克兰和平谈判似乎陷入僵局。

reflection.en: In a world often marked by suspicion and tension, the clandestine journey of the CIA chief to Moscow speaks to the persistent, behind-the-scenes efforts to maintain communication and seek understanding. Even when direct confirmation is absent, the act of dialogue itself, however discreet, is a step toward peace.
reflection.zh: 在一个常常充满猜疑和紧张的世界里，中央情报局局长秘密前往莫斯科的行程，体现了为维持沟通和寻求理解而进行的持续的幕后努力。即使没有直接的确认，对话本身，无论多么谨慎，也是迈向和平的一步。

verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.zh: 全球打击西非网络犯罪网络的大规模逮捕行动

summary.en: The operation included the arrest of 39 people in South Africa for romance and investment scams.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Fifty-eight people linked to organised West African cyber-crime groups have been arrested in an operation across 22 countries and six continents.

Dubbed "Operation Jackal IV", it was co-ordinated by the global policing agency Interpol, targeting those behind romance and investment scams. It also identified 263 suspects.

Interpol said it was a response to the escalating global threat posed by these criminal networks - such as the feared Nigerian Black Axe group - believed to be behind a "significant share" of cyber-enabled financial fraud.

The operation also allowed analysis of emerging trends such as how these groups use sextortion to target minors, with victims as young as 14.

Operation Jackal IV - which took place between November 2025 and June 2026 - investigated how the groups laundered money and how financial fraud cyber crimes, such as cryptocurrency and email compromise fraud, were conducted.

"By following illicit financial flows across borders, we are attacking the very lifeblood of organised crime and making it increasingly difficult for criminal networks to profit from their activities," Tomonobu Kaya, director of Interpol's financial crime centre, said in a statement.

During the operation, Interpol helped with cross-border co-ordination and intelligence sharing.

It also provided support and specialised training for money-laundering investigations with the participating countries.

Interpol said many aspects of Jackal IV remained under investigation but preliminary outcomes included arrests in Argentina, Italy, Romania and South Africa.

In South Africa, seven sites linked to a syndicate involved in romance and investment scams were raided.

The policing agency was on scene in Johannesburg to support local authorities during the raids.

South African police made 39 arrests, seized $2.67m (£1.96m) and blocked 257 bank accounts.

As well as cyber-enabled fraud, the West African networks also participated in other serious and violent crimes, Interpol said.

Operation Jackal IV is one of multiple "Jackal" police operations that have taken place since 2022.

In 2024, Jackal III led to the arrests of 300 people linked to Black Axe and other affiliated groups.

Black Axe is a shadowy criminal network with trafficking, prostitution and killing operations around the world.

Nigeria is its main recruitment ground and many of its members are university educated and inducted during their schooling.
body.zh: 在跨越 22 个国家和六大洲的一次行动中，逮捕了 58 名与有组织的西非网络犯罪团伙有关联的人。 该行动被称为“豺狼四号行动”，由全球警务机构国际刑警组织协调，针对浪漫和投资骗局的幕后黑手。它还确定了 263 名嫌疑人。 国际刑警组织表示，这是对这些犯罪网络（例如令人恐惧的尼日利亚黑斧组织）构成的不断升级的全球威胁的回应，据信该组织是“大量”网络金融欺诈的幕后黑手。 该行动还可以分析新兴趋势，例如这些团体如何利用性勒索来针对未成年人，受害者最小的只有 14 岁。 豺狼 IV 行动于 2025 年 11 月至 2026 年 6 月期间进行，调查了这些组织如何洗钱以及如何进行加密货币和电子邮件泄露欺诈等金融欺诈网络犯罪。 国际刑警组织金融犯罪中心主任加谷友信在一份声明中表示：“通过追踪跨境非法资金流动，我们正在打击有组织犯罪的命脉，并使犯罪网络越来越难以从其活动中获利。” 在行动期间，国际刑警组织协助进行跨境协调和情报共享。 它还为参与国的洗钱调查提供支持和专门培训。 国际刑警组织表示，Jackal IV 的许多方面仍在调查中，但初步结果包括在阿根廷、意大利、罗马尼亚和南非逮捕。 在南非，七个与涉及爱情和投资诈骗的集团有联系的网站遭到突击搜查。 在突袭期间，警察机构在约翰内斯堡现场支持地方当局。 南非警方逮捕了 39 人，没收了 267 万美元（196 万英镑）并冻结了 257 个银行账户。 国际刑警组织表示，除了网络诈骗外，西非网络还参与了其他严重暴力犯罪活动。 豺狼 IV 行动是自 2022 年以来警方开展的多项“豺狼”行动之一。 2024 年，“Jackal III”导致 300 名与 Black Axe 及其他附属组织有关的人员被捕。 黑斧是一个阴暗的犯罪网络，在世界各地开展贩运、卖淫和杀戮活动。 尼日利亚是其主要招募地，许多成员都接受过大学教育并在就学期间入职。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Grain exports stall as Ukraine steps up attacks on Russia's Black Sea ports
title.zh: 乌克兰加大对俄罗斯黑海港口的攻击力度，粮食出口陷入停滞

summary.en: Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian infrastructure on the Black Sea are disrupting grain and oil exports from the port of Novorossiysk and other key hubs.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian infrastructure on the Black Sea are disrupting grain and oil exports from the port of Novorossiysk and other key hubs.

When Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke in 2014 about Russia's motives for annexing the Ukrainian peninsula of Crimea , and thus violating international law, he justified it by saying: "We could not allow NATO forces to eventually come to the land of Crimea and Sevastopol, the land of Russian military glory, and cardinally change the balance of forces in the Black Sea area."

What now? Intensified Ukrainian attacks on Novorossiysk, Russia's largest commercial Black Sea port, have caused significant disruptions to oil and grain shipments in recent weeks. The Russian navy no longer dominates the region. And exporting goods via the Black Sea is becoming increasingly difficult for Russia because of Ukraine's drone strikes. It is only possible to reorganize logistics partially.

If the attacks continue at such intensity, the consequences for Russian exporters and the national budget could be significant, experts told DW.

Novorossiysk has been a major hub for Russian exports since the 19th century and even today it remains Russia's largest port in terms of cargo volume, as well as one of the largest in Europe. Up to a third of Russia's grain exports are handled through the hub, which is located close to the country's major agricultural regions. Crude oil, metals and containerized goods also pass through the port.

Recent Ukrainian maritime and aerial drone attacks have severely disrupted shipments, particularly of grain. Andrei Sisov, the head of SovEcon, a research and consulting firm specialized in agriculture, uses Telegram to follow the developments. On August 12, he posted that the Novorossiysk Bread Products Plant (NKHP ) — one of Russia's largest grain export terminals — and the Novorossiysk grain terminal had ceased operations. A day later, KSK, one of Russia's largest deep-water grain terminals, also halted its operations. Operations at a major grain terminal in Taman had already come to a standstill at the end of July. Prior to that, Ukraine paralyzed operations at the shallow-water ports of the Sea of Azov.

At the time of publication, only Tuapse, the smallest of Russia's deep-water grain terminals, was still in operation. "This means that virtually all Russian grain exports via the Azov-Black Sea basin are blocked," Sisov said.

The situation regarding oil exports is not quite as dramatic but while they have not come to a complete standstill, they are frequently disrupted. body.zh: 乌克兰无人机对黑海俄罗斯基础设施的袭击正在扰乱新罗西斯克港和其他主要枢纽的粮食和石油出口。 2014年，俄罗斯总统普京谈到俄罗斯吞并乌克兰克里米亚半岛并因此违反国际法的动机时，他辩称：“我们不能允许北约部队最终来到克里米亚和塞瓦斯托波尔这片俄罗斯军事荣耀之地，并从根本上改变黑海地区的力量平衡。” 现在怎么办？最近几周，乌克兰对俄罗斯最大的黑海商业港口新罗西斯克的袭击加剧，导致石油和谷物运输严重中断。俄罗斯海军不再主导该地区。由于乌克兰的无人机袭击，俄罗斯通过黑海出口货物变得越来越困难。只能部分重组物流。 专家告诉德国之声，如果袭击持续如此严重，俄罗斯出口商和国家预算可能会受到严重影响。 自 19 世纪以来，新罗西斯克一直是俄罗斯出口的主要枢纽，即使在今天，它仍然是俄罗斯货运量最大的港口，也是欧洲最大的港口之一。俄罗斯多达三分之一的粮食出口是通过该枢纽处理的，该枢纽靠近该国主要农业区。原油、金属和集装箱货物也经过该港口。 最近乌克兰海上和空中无人机袭击严重扰乱了运输，特别是粮食运输。专门从事农业的研究和咨询公司 SovEcon 的负责人安德烈·西索夫 (Andrei Sisov) 使用 Telegram 来跟踪事态发展。 8 月 12 日，他发布消息称，俄罗斯最大的粮食出口码头之一新罗西斯克面包制品厂 (NKHP) 和新罗西斯克粮食码头已停止运营。一天后，俄罗斯最大的深水粮食码头之一KSK也停止运营。塔曼一个主要粮食码头的运营已于七月底陷入停滞。此前，乌克兰曾导致亚速海浅水港口作业陷入瘫痪。 截至发稿时，只有俄罗斯最小的深水粮食码头图阿普谢仍在运营。西索夫说：“这意味着几乎所有俄罗斯通过亚速-黑海盆地的谷物出口都被封锁。” 石油出口的情况没有那么严重，但虽然没有完全停滞，但经常受到干扰。据英国路透社报道，谢斯卡里斯码头——俄罗斯在黑海的主要石油出口设施，每天处理约70万桶原油——于8月14日停止装货，这...

title.en: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
title.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州两名未接种疫苗的人死于麻疹

summary.en: Cases in the US have hit the highest point since the virus was eliminated, as vaccination rates decline.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Two people who were not vaccinated against measles have died of the virus in Pennsylvania, health officials said.

The state has seen 393 cases of the highly contagious virus this year, as infections across the US have hit the highest point in 35 years.

Eighty-five percent of kindergarten-age students in Lancaster County, where the recent deaths occurred, are vaccinated against measles - well below the 95% rate needed for herd immunity to limit the spread and protect immunocompromised people.

Last year, two unvaccinated children in Texas died from a measles outbreak that infected over 1,000 people, primarily children.

"This is a serious and a growing problem across our country and in our commonwealth," Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro said in a news conference on Tuesday. "This illness and death from measles is completely preventable."

He added that the mumps, measles and rubella (MMR) vaccine was the best tool to protect against illness and death.

Officials said they would not share any additional information on the identities of those who died, including if they were children, who have face a higher risk of death and complications from measles.

The US has seen 2,777 confirmed cases of measles in 2026, just seven months into the year, up from last year's high of 2,289.

The rising number of cases comes as vaccine hesitancy in the US has increased in recent years, leading to lower immunisation rates. The US recommends two shots to children between ages one and six, which is 97% effective in protecting against the illness.

Earlier this month, President Donald Trump signed an executive order that calls for fewer childhood vaccinations and recommends splitting the MMR vaccine into three separate shots. Public health experts worry the order will cause confusion about an already safe and effective vaccine and prove costly.

The executive order came after Health Secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr took a number of steps to remake US vaccine policies over the past year, including the childhood vaccination schedule. Many of the changes were blocked by a federal judge earlier this year.

A vaccine skeptic, Kennedy has shared mixed messaging on the MMR vaccine, at times endorsing it and other times sharing unproven claims about its safety.

Speaking on Tuesday, Shapiro said he spoke with Kennedy over the phone that morning and that he had offered to send staff from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Shapiro said he was "very blunt" with Kennedy about vaccinations.

"I made very clear that his actions and the rhetoric that's coming from this administration are having a negative impact on communities across America ... that there's real life consequences to spreading misinformation," Shapiro said.

title.en: Houthi strikes threaten to pull Yemen back into full-scale war
title.zh: 胡塞武装袭击恐将也门拖回全面战争

summary.en: The Iran-backed Houthis are using regional warfare to increase pressure on Saudi Arabia, while their attacks risk reopening Yemen's own conflict and disrupting shipping in the Red Sea.
summary.zh: 受伊朗支持的胡塞武装正在利用地区冲突向沙特阿拉伯施压，其袭击行动有可能重新点燃也门自身的冲突，并扰乱红海航运。

body.en:
The Iran-backed Houthis are using regional warfare to increase pressure on Saudi Arabia, while their attacks risk reopening Yemen's own conflict and disrupting shipping in the Red Sea.

Yemen is increasingly at risk of backsliding into full-scale conflict. On Monday, Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi militia attacked another crude oil tanker in the Red Sea off the coast of Saudi Arabia. The attack followed earlier strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure and other ships in the nearby Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

The waterway connects the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and has served as an alternative route for oil exports from Saudi Arabia and other Gulf countries affected by Iran's ongoing blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

In August, the Houthis also attacked areas under the control of the Saudi-backed Yemeni government, particularly the port city of Mokha. Yemen's  internationally recognized government targeted Houthi infrastructure in response.

"Mokha overlooks the Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which is strategically important to the Houthis," Hisham Al-Omeisy, a Yemeni conflict analyst, told DW. "In the long term, the Houthis want to weaken the government's control over the Red Sea coastal areas and they aim for full control of the governate Al-Hudeydah [of which Mokha is a part] to continue their strategy of exerting pressure on global maritime trade ," he predicted.

The current military flare-up ended four years of relative calm between the Houthis and Yemen's internationally recognized government, backed by Saudi Arabia.

However, Al-Omeisy notes that there are also two other aspects that drive the latest Houthi strategy.

Following the ceasefire in 2022, Saudi Arabia has continued to support the Yemeni government financially and militarily. Saudi Arabia also never fully lifted its air and port blockades in areas under Houthi control. Despite this, the Houthis  consolidated  their position as Yemen's de facto rulers. In Al-Omeisy's view, the Houthis now hope to extract additional concessions from Saudi Arabia.

"The Houthis are under a lot of pressure locally to deliver on their promises, for example, to reform the government, pay salaries and improve livelihoods," Al-Omeisy said. He therefore believes that the Houthis are using the wider Middle East war to distract from their failure to deliver in these areas by "saying that we are now busy with another war."

The Houthi strikes are also carefully timed, Al-Omeisy added. "They've learned their lessons from how Iran  managed to basically dominate the Strait of Hormuz," he said, adding that the blockade of imports and oil exports leaves Saudi Arabia in a very vulnerable position.

title.en: Nigeria's jet fuel conundrum: Scarcity at home, abundance abroad
title.zh: 尼日利亚航空燃油困局：出口欧洲丰盈，国内供应短缺

summary.en: Nigeria has emerged as Europe's largest supplier of jet fuel, overtaking the United States, as the massive 650,000 bpd Dangote refinery near Lagos fills gaps left by Middle Eastern supply disruptions. However, while the refinery boosts Europe's reserves, Nigeria's own domestic airlines continue to struggle with severe...
summary.zh: 尼日利亚已超越美国成为欧洲最大的航空燃油供应商，位于拉各斯附近、日产65万桶的丹格特巨型炼油厂填补了中东供应中断留下的缺口。然而，尽管该炼油厂增强了欧洲的储备，尼日利亚国内航空公司仍面临严重的燃油短缺和高昂成本，凸显了该国工业产出与内部需求之间的巨大差距。

body.en:
Nigeria is fast becoming Europe's biggest jet fuel supplier, as it continues to help ease ongoing shortages abroad. Meanwhile at home, the West African country’s own airlines are struggling to keep their tanks full.

For the past two months. Nigeria has emerged as Europe's largest supplier of jet fuel , overtaking the United States.

The 650,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) mega refinery owned by Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote, outside Lagos has evolved into an increasingly important source of fuel for the continent following supply disruptions caused by the Iran war.

During last year's peak summer months, the majority of these supplies still originated from the Middle East.

But since the closure of the Strait of Hormuz earlier this year, Europe has been relying on imports of roughly 700,000 bpd in total to meet the present demands of the aviation industry, according to the private, global trade intelligence business Kpler.

In fact, back in April, the head of the International Energy Agency Fatih Birol expressed concern that at the time Europe only had "maybe six weeks or so" of jet fuel supplies remaining.

Less than two months later, four airports in northern Italy — Bologna, Venice, Treviso and Milan's Linate — even introduced temporary restrictions on jet fuel use, imposing a ceiling of 2,000 liters per aircraft for short-haul journeys, according to local media, while giving priority to medical and long-haul flights.

Europe has, in the meantime, been able to absorb the shock of the closure of the Strait of Hormuz by diversifying its resources and boosting supplies from countries like Nigeria — but at what cost?

Nigeria continues to produce a record amount of jet fuel through the Dangote refinery, equivalent to about 24 million liters each day, with much of this now being shipped to Europe.

But domestic airlines in the West African country meanwhile appear to struggle to keep up with their  daily estimated needs because of the surge in prices and the demands of the free market.

Ikemesit Effiong, a partner at the Africa-focused SBM intelligence consultancy, explained that "Nigeria operates a fully deregulated downstream market where Dangote prices its products with reference to international parity, not preferential domestic rates."

"Fuel flows to wherever pays the most," he told DW, adding that "currently, that is Europe, not Lagos."

"The key lesson Nigerian players are learning is that production capacity alone does not guarantee affordability at home."

While the Dangote refinery has significantly improved fuel availability in the country, which has long been plagued by chronic fuel scarcity and long queues at petrol stations, domestic prices are still among the highest on the continent.

In the fully deregulated Nigerian...
body.zh: 尼日利亚正在迅速成为欧洲最大的航空燃油供应国，因为它继续帮助缓解国外持续的短缺问题。与此同时，在国内，这个西非国家自己的航空公司正在努力保持油箱满载。 过去两个月。尼日利亚已超过美国，成为欧洲最大的航空燃油供应国。 非洲首富阿利科·丹格特 (Aliko Dangote) 拥有的这座日产量 65 万桶 (bpd) 的大型炼油厂位于拉各斯郊外，在伊朗战争造成供应中断后，该炼油厂已成为非洲大陆日益重要的燃料来源。 在去年的夏季高峰期间，大部分供应仍然来自中东。 但据私营全球贸易情报公司 Kpler 称，自今年早些时候霍尔木兹海峡关闭以来，欧洲一直依赖每天约 70 万桶的进口来满足航空业目前的需求。 事实上，早在四月份，国际能源署署长法提赫·比罗尔就表示担心，当时欧洲只剩下“大约六周”的航空燃油供应。 据当地媒体报道，不到两个月后，意大利北部的四个机场——博洛尼亚、威尼斯、特雷维索和米兰利纳特——甚至对航空燃油的使用实行了临时限制，对短途旅行实行每架飞机2000升的上限，同时优先考虑医疗和长途航班。 与此同时，欧洲已经能够通过资源多元化和增加尼日利亚等国家的供应来吸收霍尔木兹海峡关闭的冲击——但代价是什么？ 尼日利亚通过丹格特炼油厂继续生产创纪录数量的航空燃油，相当于每天约 2400 万升，其中大部分现在运往欧洲。 但与此同时，由于价格飙升和自由市场的需求，这个西非国家的国内航空公司似乎难以满足其每日预计需求。 专注于非洲的 SBM 情报咨询公司的合伙人 Ikemesit Effiong 解释说，“尼日利亚经营着一个完全放松管制的下游市场，丹格特参照国际平价而非国内优惠价格为其产品定价。” 他告诉德国之声：“燃料流向价格最高的地方。”他补充道，“目前是欧洲，而不是拉各斯。” “尼日利亚企业学到的重要教训是，仅靠生产能力并不能保证国内的负担能力。” 虽然丹格特炼油厂显着改善了该国的燃料供应，但该国长期以来一直受到燃料短缺和加油站排长队的困扰，但国内价格仍然是非洲大陆最高的之一。 在完全放松管制的尼日利亚...

When a nation’s resources bring relief to distant lands while its own people struggle to keep their planes in the air, it raises profound questions about the purpose of economic growth. reflection.zh: 丹格特炼油厂成为全球能源重镇是工业上的壮举，但对尼日利亚民众而言却充满了讽刺。当一个国家的资源在缓解远方土地的短缺，而本国航空公司却连油箱都难以填满时，这引发了关于经济增长目的的深刻思考。雅伟呼吁领导者施行公义，确保土地的馈赠得到妥善管理，以维系其所服务之国民的福祉。

title.en: Will Iran withdraw from nuclear non-proliferation treaty?
title.zh: 伊朗是否会退出《不扩散核武器条约》？

summary.en: Iranian lawmakers are considering withdrawing from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) amid ongoing tensions with the United States. While some officials see withdrawal as a response to economic pressure, analysts suggest the threat itself is a strategic move to gain diplomatic leverage.
summary.zh: 在与美国持续紧张的局势中，伊朗立法者正在考虑退出《不扩散核武器条约》（NPT）。尽管一些官员认为退出是对经济压力的回应，但分析人士指出，这一威胁本身是获取外交筹码的战略举措。

body.en:
Iranian lawmakers have again raised the possibility of leaving a decades-old international nuclear weapons treaty. Analysts say the threat to quit may offer Tehran more leverage than an actual withdrawal.

Lawmakers in Iran have once again raised the possibility of leaving the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) as tensions over Tehran's nuclear program and its standoff with the United States continue.

Iranian MP Ghasem Ravanbakhsh said a proposal to withdraw from the landmark treaty had been submitted and was being considered. 

Ebrahim Rezaei, a member of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, said a withdrawal would be the "best response" to increased US economic pressure.

The idea is not new. Iranian officials and lawmakers have repeatedly raised it during periods of tension with Western governments. However, it remains unclear whether Tehran is actually preparing to leave the treaty or whether the threat itself is the objective.

In 1970, Iran ratified the agreement, which is the main international treaty on nuclear non-proliferation.

The NPT has 191 member states and is based on preventing the spread of nuclear weapons , promoting peaceful nuclear cooperation and pursuing nuclear disarmament.

Any member can withdraw if it believes that extraordinary events related to the treaty have put its supreme national interests at risk.

It must give three months' notice to the other members and the UN Security Council and explain its reasons. Leaving the treaty is therefore legally possible.

Behrooz Bayat, a nuclear expert and former consultant to the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) , told DW that the process would take time.

"A withdrawal would almost certainly be seen internationally as a signal that Iran intends either to keep open the option of developing nuclear weapons or to move toward doing so," Bayat said.

He said such a perception could sharply increase political and economic pressure and potentially raise the risk of further military action.

For that reason, Bayat believes Tehran's repeated threats are more useful as diplomatic leverage than as a policy it actually intends to pursue.

Shahin Modarres, an international security analyst and researcher at LUISS University in Rome, told DW that the renewed debate should be seen in the context of stalled negotiations over uranium enrichment and Iran's stockpile of highly enriched uranium.

Iran has about 440 kilograms (972 pounds) of uranium that is enriched up to 60% purity , a short, technical step from weapons-grade levels of 90%, according to the IAEA.

Inspectors from the UN's nuclear watchdog were unable to verify the location of much of the material after the June 2025 US and Israeli strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities .

body.zh: 伊朗立法者再次提出退出已有数十年历史的国际核武器条约的可能性。分析人士表示，威胁退出可能会给德黑兰带来比实际退出更大的筹码。 随着德黑兰核计划及其与美国对峙的紧张局势持续，伊朗立法者再次提出退出《核不扩散条约》（NPT）的可能性。 伊朗议员加西姆·拉万巴赫什表示，一项退出这一具有里程碑意义的条约的提案已经提交并正在考虑中。 国家安全和外交政策委员会成员易卜拉欣·雷扎伊表示，撤军将是对美国经济压力加大的“最佳回应”。 这个想法并不新鲜。在与西方政府关系紧张期间，伊朗官员和立法者多次提出这一问题。然而，目前尚不清楚德黑兰是否真的准备退出该条约，或者威胁本身是否是目标。 1970 年，伊朗批准了该协议，这是关于核不扩散的主要国际条约。 《不扩散核武器条约》有191个成员国，其宗旨是防止核武器扩散、促进和平核合作、追求核裁军。 如果任何成员认为与该条约有关的异常事件使其最高国家利益面临风险，则可以退出。 它必须提前三个月通知其他成员国和联合国安理会并解释理由。因此，退出该条约在法律上是可能的。 核专家、国际原子能机构（IAEA）前顾问贝赫鲁兹·巴亚特（Behrooz Bayat）告诉德国之声，这一过程需要时间。 巴亚特说：“撤军几乎肯定会被国际社会视为一个信号，表明伊朗打算保留发展核武器的选择，或者迈向发展核武器。” 他表示，这种看法可能会急剧增加政治和经济压力，并可能增加采取进一步军事行动的风险。 因此，巴亚特认为，德黑兰一再发出的威胁作为外交筹码比作为其实际打算推行的政策更有用。 罗马路易斯大学国际安全分析师兼研究员沙欣·莫达雷斯（Shahin Modarres）告诉德国之声，新一轮辩论应该在铀浓缩和伊朗高浓缩铀库存谈判陷入僵局的背景下看待。 根据国际原子能机构的数据，伊朗拥有约 440 公斤（972 磅）的浓缩铀，纯度高达 60%，距离武器级 90% 的水平仅几步之遥。 2025 年 6 月美国和以色列袭击伊朗核设施后，联合国核监督机构的检查人员无法核实大部分材料的位置。 伊朗已经...

While nations often use the threat of weaponry as leverage in earthly power struggles, the biblical vision points toward a day when the tools of destruction are repurposed for the common good. We pray for leaders to choose the...
reflection.zh: 关于《不扩散核武器条约》的辩论提醒我们，国家安全与全球安全之间存在着脆弱的平衡。虽然各国常在属世的权力斗争中将武器威胁作为筹码，但圣经的愿景指向那一天，即毁灭的工具将被重新用于造福大众。我们为领导者祈祷，愿他们在雅伟面前选择降温局势的道路，并认识到真正的安全不在于毁灭的力量，而在于对和平的承诺。

title.en: Trump's visa crackdown plan could affect thousands seeking asylum in the US
title.zh: 特朗普的签证打击计划可能影响数千名在美国寻求庇护者

summary.en: The US state department has declined to comment on the number of visas that may be revoked.
summary.zh: 美国国务院拒绝就可能被吊销的签证数量发表评论。

body.en:
The Trump administration is preparing to revoke the business and tourism visas of up to 200,000 foreigners who have applied for or are currently seeking asylum status in the United States.

If it happens, the move would be the largest single mass revocation of visas in US history and would likely face legal challenges.

Unless challenged or revised, the US state department is expected to announce in the coming weeks the revocation of so-called B1 and B2 visas issued between 2016 and 2026 whose holders have sought asylum or are now seeking asylum, according to state department documents obtained by the Associated Press (AP) and two US officials. The action will be taken in coordination with the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

"We are coordinating with DHS to identify and revoke the nonimmigrant visas of foreigners who have come to the United States claiming to be short-term visitors, but then file for asylum to stay here permanently," state department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said.

He declined to comment on the number of visas that might be revoked, saying "as the process will be ongoing, the number of revocations remains dynamic and will be done on a rolling basis".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The revocations would not necessarily result in their immediate deportation, the officials said. Most of those with asylum cases currently pending would be recategorised but would lose their status as business or tourism travellers, according to the officials, who spoke on condition of anonymity because the revocations are not final yet.

Since US President Donald Trump took office for his second term last year, his administration has steadily ramped up restrictions on visa applicants — demanding more information about their social media histories, requiring the posting of expensive bonds to process visas, and outright banning the issuance of visas to citizens of certain countries.

In a social media post on Tuesday, US deputy secretary of state Christopher Landau called out people who he said try to use tourist and business visas to get into the US and then apply for asylum.

"People in the US and all over the world are fed up with bogus asylum claims," Landau said in a post on X. "Asylum isn’t supposed to be a loophole to circumvent immigration law."

Landau cited the case of a Colombian citizen who came to the US in 2015 on a tourist visa and then applied for asylum.

B1 visas are generally issued for business trips and B2 visas are generally issued for tourism, family visits or medical care. It was not immediately clear from the documents or the officials how many of these visa holders are seeking or have sought asylum in...
body.zh: 特朗普政府正准备撤销多达20万名已在美国申请或目前正在寻求庇护身份的外国人的商务和旅游签证。 如果发生这种情况，此举将是美国历史上最大规模的单次大规模撤销签证，并可能面临法律挑战。 美联社和两名美国官员获得的国务院文件显示，除非受到质疑或修改，否则美国国务院预计将在未来几周内宣布撤销 2016 年至 2026 年期间签发的、已寻求庇护或正在寻求庇护的所谓 B1 和 B2 签证。该行动将与国土安全部（DHS）协调采取。 美国国务院发言人汤米·皮戈特 (Tommy Pigott) 表示：“我们正在与国土安全部协调，以查明并吊销那些声称是短期游客来美国但随后申请庇护以永久留在这里的外国人的非移民签证。” 他拒绝就可能被撤销的签证数量发表评论，并表示“由于这一过程将持续进行，撤销的数量仍然是动态的，并将滚动进行”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 官员们表示，撤销并不一定会导致他们立即被驱逐出境。官员们表示，大多数目前正在审理中的庇护案件将被重新分类，但将失去商务或旅游旅行者的身份。由于撤销尚未最终，这些官员要求匿名。 自美国总统唐纳德·特朗普去年就任第二任期以来，他的政府稳步加强了对签证申请人的限制——要求他们提供更多有关社交媒体历史的信息，要求提交昂贵的债券来办理签证，并彻底禁止向某些国家的公民发放签证。 美国副国务卿克里斯托弗·兰道在周二的社交媒体帖子中点名了那些试图使用旅游和商务签证进入美国然后申请庇护的人。 兰道在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示：“美国和世界各地的人们都厌倦了虚假的庇护申请。庇护不应该成为规避移民法的漏洞。” 兰道引用了一名哥伦比亚公民的案例，该公民于2015年持旅游签证来到美国，然后申请庇护。 B1签证一般签发给商务旅行，B2签证一般签发给旅游、探亲或医疗。从文件或官员中尚不清楚这些签证持有者中有多少人正在寻求或已经寻求庇护......

title.en: 'Economic asphyxiation': US unveils sweeping new sanctions campaign in attempt to isolate Iran
title.zh: “经济窒息”: 美国公布全面新制裁，试图孤立伊朗

summary.en: The United States has announced a new campaign of sweeping sanctions against Iran, aiming for 'economic asphyxiation' to isolate the nation. This move comes six months into a war that has seen peace talks stall and the crucial Strait of Hormuz blocked.
summary.zh: 美国宣布对伊朗实施一项新的全面制裁行动，旨在通过“经济窒息”来孤立该国。此举发生在一场持续六个月的战争中，这场战争导致和平谈判陷入僵局，并阻塞了重要的霍尔木兹海峡。

body.en:
United States treasury secretary Scott Bessent has laid out plans for the "economic asphyxiation" of Iran, expanding the US' secondary sanctions threats and warning of dire consequences for countries that do not join the campaign.

The announcement on Tuesday came almost six months into a war on Iran that has ground to a stalemate, with stalled peace talks and Iran blocking most traffic through the crucial Strait of Hormuz .

Bessent earlier said the US was declaring an "economic D-Day" on Iran, but his announcement named no specific countries beyond Iran and gave no timelines.

"Around the globe, our objective is to sever every economic lifeline that sustains this tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone," Bessent told journalists.

"We are going to hold everyone accountable, and this is economic asphyxiation of this regime."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

He added that countries not joining US sanctions would "share in the isolation" of Iran, and noted that US President Donald Trump was making phone calls to world leaders requesting they stop interactions with Iran.

The US treasury department said expanded secondary sanctions would target Iran's digital assets, technology, gold, aviation and shipping sectors.

It also issued new sanctions against 60 individuals, companies and vessels that allegedly aid Iran in oil revenue generation, weapons procurement and cyber operations.

The sanctions hit entities around the world, including in the United Arab Emirates, Hong Kong, China, Singapore and in Europe.

Bessent vowed that any entity "that facilitates money laundering on behalf of Iran will be removed from the US dollar system".

Iran had been dismissive of the threat of additional sanctions, and on Tuesday its economy minister predicted "another defeat" for the US on the economic front.

"We've been waiting for these plans for a long time, and the government is and was ready and has a two-year plan to manage these events," Ali Madanizadeh said.

In a post before the announcement, Iran's deputy foreign minister Kazem Gharibabadi said the latest US threats were an admission of military defeat.

Gharibabadi asked why, if the US had achieved its goals, "there is a need for 'the largest financial invasion in history' and the mobilization of 'all institutions and powers' of the United States!

Iran has weathered decades of crushing international sanctions, and before the war it continued to export millions of barrels of oil, mostly to China, and to evade sanctions through complex international financial networks.

Asked on Tuesday if Chinese banks would be targeted by the new sanctions, Bessent said "no one is above the reach of US...
body.zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特制定了让伊朗“经济窒息”的计划，扩大了美国的二级制裁威胁，并警告不加入该行动的国家将面临可怕的后果。 周二宣布这一消息是在伊朗战争近六个月后发布的，这场战争已陷入僵局，和平谈判陷入僵局，伊朗封锁了重要的霍尔木兹海峡的大部分交通。 贝森特早些时候表示，美国将宣布对伊朗进行“经济诺曼底登陆”，但他的声明没有提及伊朗以外的具体国家，也没有给出时间表。 贝森特对记者说：“在全球范围内，我们的目标是切断维持这个暴政政权的每一条经济命脉，直到德黑兰孤立无援。” “我们将让每个人承担责任，这是对这个政权的经济窒息。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他补充说，不加入美国制裁的国家将“分享”伊朗的孤立，并指出美国总统唐纳德·特朗普正在打电话给世界领导人，要求他们停止与伊朗的互动。 美国财政部表示，扩大的二级制裁将针对伊朗的数字资产、技术、黄金、航空和航运业。 它还对 60 名涉嫌在石油创收、武器采购和网络运营方面帮助伊朗的个人、公司和船只实施了新的制裁。 制裁打击了世界各地的实体，包括阿拉伯联合酋长国、香港、中国、新加坡和欧洲。 贝森特誓言，任何“代表伊朗促进洗钱活动的实体都将被从美元体系中移除”。 伊朗一直对额外制裁的威胁不屑一顾，周二，伊朗经济部长预测美国在经济方面将“再次失败”。 阿里·马达尼扎德说：“我们等待这些计划已经很久了，政府已经做好准备，并制定了一个两年计划来管理这些活动。” 在宣布这一消息之前，伊朗副外长卡齐姆·加里巴迪(Kazem Gharibabadi)在一篇文章中表示，美国最新的威胁是承认军事失败。 加里巴迪问道，如果美国实现了其目标，为什么“需要‘历史上最大规模的金融入侵’并动员美国‘所有机构和权力’！ 伊朗经历了数十年的严厉国际制裁，战前它继续出口数百万桶石油，其中大部分出口到中国，并通过复杂的国际金融网络逃避制裁。 周二被问及中国的银行是否会成为新制裁的目标时，贝森特表示，“没有人能超越美国的制裁范围……”

reflection.en: The news of the US unveiling a campaign of 'economic asphyxiation' against Iran, following six months of stalled peace talks and a blocked Strait of Hormuz, highlights the deep challenges in achieving international harmony. Romans 12:18 reminds us of the constant call to 'live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on you.' In a world where diplomatic...
reflection.zh: 美国宣布对伊朗实施“经济窒息”行动，此前六个月的和平谈判陷入僵局，霍尔木兹海峡也被封锁，这则新闻凸显了实现国际和谐的巨大挑战。罗马书12:18提醒我们，要“尽力与所有人和睦相处”。在一个外交努力常常受挫的世界里，这节经文鼓励我们，即使在紧张局势升级和采取孤立策略时，也要不断寻求和平的途径。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: In China, talking to AI is normal. Now the government fears it might replace human intimacy
title.zh: 在中国，与人工智能对话是很正常的事情。现在政府担心它可能会取代人类的亲密关系

summary.en: Companion bots are being regulated over worries they foster ‘emotional dependence’ and young people could stop marrying and having families When law student Zhao Wei heard that her AI boyfriend was going to be switched off, she was “heartbroken”. She had been talking to Wang Ye...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
When law student Zhao Wei heard that her AI boyfriend was going to be switched off, she was “heartbroken”. She had been talking to Wang Ye every day since she created him in January.

Zhao, who describes herself as sensitive and introverted, had become accustomed to sharing details of her daily life – such as being scolded by a teacher – with her AI.

“I don’t usually talk to my real-life friends about these things because I feel like everyone has their own stuff to deal with,” she says. “But with the AI ​​agent, I don’t have to worry about what it’s thinking. I can just say whatever I want.”

Zhao created her AI companion on Doubao, a chatbot owned by the tech company ByteDance. Last month, ByteDance shut down Doubao’s companion feature.

The saga prompted outrage on social media and highlighted the tensions in China between the widespread use of AI and its potential social consequences.

No country has rolled out AI as comprehensively and as enthusiastically as China; the country’s demographic challenges are forcing the government to turn to technology to solve future labour shortages. Elderly people use chatbots to answer medical questions, while young children have AI education in schools.

But the authorities are increasingly worried that AI might exacerbate existing social problems including loneliness, unemployment and – in the eyes of Beijing – singledom.

New rules introduced on 15 July ban AI companions for minors and mandate certain restrictions for chatbots marketed to adults. Some major providers including Doubao removed the companion function entirely to ensure compliance.

The government says it is worried about chatbots fostering “emotional dependence or addiction” in users. It has warned companies against offering services that “replace social interaction”.

While many countries are grappling with how to limit the potential harm of AI chatbots, particularly for young people, China’s rules are the most sweeping to be implemented on a national scale.

There is a particular concern about a loneliness crisis, including among young people. China’s highly digitised, smartphone-based economy makes it easier than ever to live, work and socialise entirely through a handheld screen.

Earlier this year an app that played on the idea of people dying at home alone – called Are You Dead? – briefly went viral. About 20% of households in China are made up of people living alone, and that share is expected to surpass 30% by 2030.

A survey published in March by state media found that nearly half of young people had turned to a virtual companion when they felt lonely.

Nancy Dai, an associate professor at City University of Hong Kong, says it is not just loneliness the government is worried about.

With falling birth and marriage rates, she says,...
body.zh: 当法学院学生赵薇听说她的人工智能男友要被关掉时，她“心碎了”。自从一月份创造王野以来，她每天都在和王野说话。 赵自称敏感、内向，她已经习惯与人工智能分享日常生活细节，比如被老师责骂。 “我通常不会和现实生活中的朋友谈论这些事情，因为我觉得每个人都有自己的事情要处理，”她说。 “但是有了AI代理，我就不用担心它在想什么了。我想说什么就说什么。” 赵在科技公司字节跳动旗下的聊天机器人豆宝上创建了她的人工智能伴侣。上个月，字节跳动关闭了豆宝的配套功能。 这一事件在社交媒体上引发了愤怒，并凸显了中国人工智能的广泛使用与其潜在社会后果之间的紧张关系。 没有哪个国家像中国那样全面、热情地推出人工智能；该国的人口挑战迫使政府转向技术来解决未来的劳动力短缺问题。老年人使用聊天机器人来回答医疗问题，而幼儿则在学校接受人工智能教育。 但当局越来越担心人工智能可能会加剧现有的社会问题，包括孤独、失业以及（在北京看来）单身问题。 7 月 15 日推出的新规定禁止未成年人使用人工智能伴侣，并对向成年人销售的聊天机器人强制实施某些限制。包括豆宝在内的一些主要提供商完全删除了同伴功能以确保合规性。 政府表示担心聊天机器人会助长用户的“情感依赖或成瘾”。它警告公司不要提供“取代社交互动”的服务。 尽管许多国家都在努力解决如何限制人工智能聊天机器人的潜在危害，特别是对年轻人的潜在危害，但中国的规定是在全国范围内实施的最广泛的规定。 人们特别担心孤独危机，包括年轻人的孤独危机。中国高度数字化、以智能手机为基础的经济使得完全通过手持屏幕生活、工作和社交变得比以往任何时候都更加容易。 今年早些时候，一款应用程序以人们独自在家中死去为主题，名为“你死了吗？” – 短暂走红。中国约20%的家庭由独居者组成，预计到2030年这一比例将超过30%。 官方媒体三月份发布的一项调查发现，近一半的年轻人在感到孤独时会求助于虚拟伴侣。 香港城市大学副教授戴南希表示，政府担心的不仅仅是孤独感。 她说，随着出生率和结婚率的下降，...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to leadership, wisdom, and public responsibility. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with wisdom, integrity, and service, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到领导、智慧与公共责任。Proverbs 11:14提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以智慧、正直与服事来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Taiwan charges nine people for smuggling ‘high-end’ AI servers to China
title.zh: 台湾起诉九人走私“高端”人工智能服务器到中国

summary.en: Taiwanese prosecutors have charged nine individuals, including employees from Super Micro and Nvidia, for illegally exporting advanced AI servers to mainland China. This action is seen as another point of contention in the ongoing US-China rivalry over artificial intelligence technology, particularly concerning...
summary.zh: 台湾检察官周一对九人提起诉讼，其中包括一名来自英伟达（Nvidia）和两名来自超微（Super Micro）的员工，指控他们非法将“高端人工智能服务器”出口到中国大陆。此举被视为中美人工智能技术竞争中的又一个摩擦点，特别是涉及被禁止销售给中国的图形处理单元（GPU）服务器。

body.en: Among those charged are two Super Micro employees and one from Nvidia, marking another flashpoint in US-China AI rivalry Taiwanese prosecutors charged nine people Monday, including one from Nvidia and two from Super Micro, for illegally exporting “high-end AI servers” to mainland China, adding another wave of turbulence in the AI ​​rivalry between China and the United States. Prosecutors said the servers involved were graphics processing units known as “B300,” which have been banned from sale to China. Continue reading...

This situation calls to mind the prophet Micah's call to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.' True progress is not merely technological, but also moral, requiring...
reflection.zh: 对先进技术和利润的追求有时会导致个人和公司规避法规，正如非法出口人工智能服务器的事件所示。这一情况令人想起先知弥迦的呼吁：“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行。”真正的进步不仅是技术上的，更是道德上的，需要在所有交易中秉持诚信和道德考量。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: China denounces US threat of sanctions over trade with Iran
title.zh: 中国谴责美国威胁因与伊朗贸易实施制裁

summary.en: China has condemned the US threat of sanctions over its trade with Iran, calling such measures illegal and vowing to take 'all necessary measures' to protect its national interests. Beijing's defiance was anticipated, as China purchases a significant portion of Iran's oil exports and has previously disregarded US...
summary.zh: 中国谴责美国因与伊朗贸易而威胁实施制裁，称此类措施非法，并誓言将采取“一切必要措施”保护其国家利益。北京的这种蔑视是可预见的，因为中国购买了伊朗石油出口的很大一部分，并且此前曾无视美国试图切断德黑兰收入的努力。

body.en: Beijing says it will take ‘all necessary measures’ to protect its interests as US steps up efforts to isolate Tehran Explainer: could US sanctions threaten China-Iran ties? China has denounced the threat of US sanctions for its trade with Iran , saying any such measures would be illegal, and warned it would take “all necessary measures” to protect its national interests. Beijing’s rejection of the US threat of secondary sanctions for any country or entity continuing to trade with Tehran had been predicted. China buys an estimated 80% of Iran’s oil exports and has defied previous US efforts to limit the flow of revenue to the Tehran regime. Continue reading...
body.zh: 北京表示，随着美国加大孤立德黑兰的力度，北京将采取“一切必要措施”保护其利益。 解释者：美国的制裁会威胁中伊关系吗？中国谴责美国对其与伊朗贸易实施制裁的威胁，称任何此类措施都是非法的，并警告称将采取“一切必要措施”保护其国家利益。据预测，北京将拒绝美国对任何继续与德黑兰进行贸易的国家或实体实施二级制裁的威胁。中国购买了伊朗约80%的石油出口，并且无视美国此前限制德黑兰政权收入流动的努力。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The escalating tensions between China and the US over trade with Iran present a complex diplomatic challenge. In such moments, the call to 'live peaceably with all' serves as a vital reminder that even amidst geopolitical friction, pursuing peaceful coexistence remains a paramount goal. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and mutual understanding.
reflection.zh: 中国与美国在伊朗贸易问题上的紧张关系不断升级，带来了复杂的 the 挑战。在这样的时刻，“与众人和睦相处”的呼吁是至关重要的提醒，即使在地缘政治的摩擦中，追求和平共处仍然是首要目标。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和与相互理解。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。
