Police said the taxi driver, heading towards Tung Chung, attempted to overtake a truck in the same lane on Cheung Tung Road at around 8pm. He then swerved into the opposite lane but crashed into a route DB03P bus from Discovery Bay to Sunny Bay MTR station. The taxi also collided with the truck before coming to a standstill. The taxi driver, 59, was...
body.zh: 周二晚上，一名香港出租车司机的车辆在大屿山与一辆巴士和一辆卡车相撞，造成死亡、11人受伤。警方表示，该的士司机于晚上8时左右前往东涌，试图在翔东路同车道超越一辆卡车。随后，他转向对面车道，却撞上了一辆由愉景湾往欣澳港铁站的 DB03P 巴士。出租车也与卡车相撞，然后才停下来。 59岁的出租车司机是...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Store slapped with 30-day ban over forced shopping
title.zh: 商店因强迫购物被禁30天

summary.en: Kaiser Jewellery International Limited has been banned from receiving inbound tour groups for 30 days, from Wednesday to September 24. The Travel Industry Authority imposed the suspension after the company failed to prevent forced shopping involving mainland visitors in February and did not take appropriate measures...
summary.zh: 一家名为Kaiser Jewellery International Limited的公司已被禁止接收入境旅游团30天，禁令将从周三持续至9月24日。旅游业监管局实施此项暂停措施，因该公司未能阻止涉及内地游客的强迫购物行为，并且未采取适当措施防止未经授权的人员在店内进行推广活动。

body.en: A company linked to forced shopping has been banned from receiving inbound tour groups for 30 days. The Travel Industry Authority said on Tuesday that the suspension of Kaiser Jewellery International Limited, which is registered under the Administrative Scheme for Registered Shops for Inbound Tour Groups, will last from Wednesday to September 24. The shop sells various items including jewellery and clothing. The authority said it had failed to prevent forced shopping involving mainland visitors in February. It also failed to take appropriate measures to ensure that no unauthorised personnel would carry out promotional activities inside the store, the authority added. The watchdog said it has zero tolerance for forced shopping and any behaviour that damages the reputation of Hong Kong’s tourism industry. It also ordered directors, managers and all frontline staff of the shop to complete training courses within a month. The authority added that it had engaged in exchanges with mainland authorities to step up supervision. DAB lawmaker Nixie Lam welcomed the 30-day suspension, saying any misconduct that harms tourists’ interests and damages Hong Kong’s image must be punished. “It does send a pretty powerful industry-wide reminder that those registered shops cannot simply just profit from doing this sort of thing,” she told RTHK. “I think it is important for all those shop owners and also their shop staff to understand that pressuring visitors or having all these sort of illegal acts are something that we really need to stop immediately.” She added that all registered shops authorised to receive tour groups are duty-bound to protect the interests of travellers. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 一家涉嫌强迫购物的公司被禁止接待入境旅游团30天。旅游业监管局周二表示，根据入境旅游团注册店铺管理计划注册的凯撒珠宝国际有限公司将暂停营业，为期周三至9月24日。该店出售珠宝和服装等多种商品。当局表示，二月份未能阻止大陆游客被迫购物。当局补充说，该公司也未能采取适当措施确保未经授权的人员不会在店内进行促销活动。该监管机构表示，对强制购物以及任何损害香港旅游业声誉的行为采取零容忍态度。并要求该店的董事、经理和所有一线员工在一个月内完成培训课程。该局补充说，已与内地当局进行交流，以加强监管。民建联议员林郑月娥对暂停30天表示欢迎，并表示任何损害游客利益和损害香港形象的不当行为都必须受到惩罚。 “这确实向全行业发出了一个非常有力的提醒，即那些注册商店不能仅仅通过做这种事情来获利，”她告诉香港电台。 “我认为，对于所有店主和店员来说，了解向游客施压或所有这些非法行为是我们真正需要立即停止的事情，这一点很重要。”她补充说，所有有权接待旅行团的注册商店都有责任保护游客的利益。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The Travel Industry Authority's action against Kaiser Jewellery International Limited highlights the importance of ethical conduct in business. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. This principle applies not only to personal interactions but also to commercial dealings, ensuring that customers are treated with fairness...
reflection.zh: 旅游业监管局对Kaiser Jewellery International Limited采取的行动，凸显了商业道德操守的重要性。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与神同行。这一原则不仅适用于个人互动，也适用于商业交易，确保顾客受到公平和尊重的对待，而非遭受强迫。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Crunch culture and tight timelines blamed for 15 construction site deaths this year
title.zh: 今年香港建筑工地因“紧迫文化”和严格工期导致15人死亡

summary.en: Construction industry representatives in Hong Kong have attributed 15 fatal worksite accidents this year to a pervasive "crunch culture" and tight timelines. Union chair Chau Sze-kit explained that this environment pushes management to prioritize speed and convenience, leading to shortcuts on safety procedures to meet...
summary.zh: 香港建筑业代表将今年发生的15起致命工地事故归咎于普遍存在的“紧迫文化”和严格的工期。工会主席周思杰解释说，这种环境促使管理层优先考虑速度和便利，为了赶工期和避免罚款，从而在安全程序上走捷径。

body.en: Construction sector representatives have blamed the industry’s crunch culture for the 15 fatal worksite accidents recorded in Hong Kong since the beginning of this year. Construction workers in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Speaking on RTHK radio, Hong Kong Construction Industry Employees General Union chair Chau Sze-kit said that aloof attitudes toward occupational safety stem from a pervasive culture of rushing work at construction sites, pushing workers to prioritise convenience and foregoing precautions. “When frontline management faces deadlines and potential penalties, they may choose to take shortcuts on certain safety procedures,” Chau said in Cantonese. Chau also said the industry-wide practice of awarding contracts to the lowest bidder meant safety was sacrificed for speed, adding that contractors may offload the pressure they face to subcontractors who have “no bargaining power.” Speaking on the same RTHK programme, Lawrence Ng, chair of the Construction Workers Registration Board at the Construction Industry Council, said that worksite bosses are often pressed to get more done in less time to compensate for increasingly frequent delays caused by extreme weather. A worker at a construction site in Hong Kong on February 13, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. He cited a survey conducted by the Council indicating that 5 to 7 per cent of frontline managers and workers have “extremely weak” safety awareness. Safety culture Ng’s remarks come a day after Construction Industry Council chairperson Thomas Ho said during a construction safety event that worksite fatalities are continuing to climb in spite of harsher penalties levied against negligent employers. In April 2023, Hong Kong amended the Occupational Safety and Occupational Health Legislation Ordinance , raising the maximum penalty for employers who commit serious safety violations from HK$500,000 to HK$10 million. Violators also face up to two years in prison. Ho said the 15 deaths so far this year was an increase compared to before the penalty was raised. “Safety culture hasn’t made its way to the worksite,” Ho said in Cantonese. “Out of the 15 [fatalities]… even a safety supervisor died. Why? Because we have only paid lip service and haven’t truly fulfilled our responsibility.” Construction workers in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Crunch culture is one of the biggest killers on construction sites,” he added. Delivering an address at the same event, Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said that worksite accidents more broadly had decreased by 20 per cent between 2023 and 2025, following the implementation of the “4S” Smart Site Safety System. This enables early identification of potential safety hazards through smart devices and communication networks for...
body.zh: 建筑业代表将今年年初以来香港发生的 15 起工地致命事故归咎于该行业的加班文化。香港的建筑工人。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港建造业总工会主席周士杰在香港电台发表讲话时表示，对职业安全的冷漠态度源于建筑工地普遍存在的赶工文化，促使工人优先考虑方便而忽视预防措施。 “当一线管理层面临最后期限和潜在的处罚时，他们可能会选择在某些安全程序上走捷径，”周用粤语说。周还表示，全行业将合同授予最低投标人的做法意味着为了速度而牺牲安全，并补充说承包商可能会将他们面临的压力转嫁给“没有讨价还价能力”的分包商。建造业议会建造业工人注册管理局主席吴遵义在香港电台同一节目中表示，工地老板经常被迫在更短的时间内完成更多工作，以弥补极端天气造成的日益频繁的延误。 2023 年 2 月 13 日，香港建筑工地的一名工人。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。他援引该委员会进行的一项调查显示，5％至7％的一线管理人员和工人的安全意识“极薄弱”。安全文化 吴恩达发表上述言论的前一天，建造业议会主席托马斯·何（Thomas Ho）在一次建筑安全活动中表示，尽管对疏忽的雇主处以更严厉的处罚，但工地死亡人数仍在继续攀升。 2023年4月，香港修订《职业安全及职业健康法例条例》，将严重违反安全规定的雇主的最高罚款由50万港元提高至1,000万港元。违法者还将面临最高两年的监禁。何说，今年迄今为止的15人死亡人数比提高处罚前有所增加。 “安全文化还没有深入到工地，”何先生用粤语说道。 “15人（死亡）中……连一名安全主管都死了。为什么？因为我们只是说说而已，并没有真正履行我们的责任。”香港的建筑工人。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “紧缩文化是建筑工地最大的杀手之一，”他补充道。发展局局长伯纳黛特·林恩 (Bernadette Linn) 在同一活动中发表讲话时表示，在实施“4S”智能工地安全系统后，2023 年至 2025 年间，工地事故总体减少了 20%。这使得能够通过智能设备和通信网络及早识别潜在的安全隐患......

reflection.en: The tragic loss of 15 lives in Hong Kong's construction sector this year, attributed to a "crunch culture" that prioritizes deadlines over safety, reminds us of the profound dangers when financial pressures overshadow human well-being. Yahweh's word warns that the love of money can be a root of all kinds of evil, and here we see its devastating impact on...
reflection.zh: 今年香港建筑业因“紧迫文化”而导致15人丧生，这提醒我们，当经济压力凌驾于人的福祉之上时，会带来多么深重的危险。雅伟的话语警告我们，贪财是万恶之根，在此我们看到它对被迫放弃预防措施的工人造成了毁灭性的影响。这种情况呼吁我们重新评估行业惯例，确保没有人为了速度或利润而牺牲生命。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...
reflection.zh: 邹幸彤等活动家在囚禁中仍坚定不移地发出真理之声，这提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为弱势群体发声。雅伟的话语鼓励我们为那些不能为自己说话的人，特别是贫困和权利被剥夺的人，开口辩护。她在狱中的文字体现了对正义和自由的深刻承诺，即使为此付出个人代价。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Strong oyster reefs start with genetic diversity
title.zh: 强大的牡蛎礁始于基因多样性

summary.en: The European flat oyster, once common in the North Sea, has become so scarce that it no longer forms ecologically functioning reefs, leading to the disappearance of habitats for over 100 marine species. Restoration efforts are now focused on bringing back both the oyster and its associated biodiversity.
summary.zh: 欧洲扁平牡蛎曾广泛分布于北海，但现在数量稀少，已无法形成具有生态功能的礁石，导致100多种海洋物种的栖息地消失。目前的恢复工作不仅关注欧洲扁平牡蛎本身，也关注礁石及其相关的生物多样性。

body.en: The European flat oyster (Ostrea edulis) was once widespread but has now become so scarce in the North Sea that it no longer forms ecologically functioning reefs. Along with the demise of the flat oyster, the three-dimensional structures that provide habitat for more than 100 marine species have disappeared. Restoration therefore focuses not only on the return of the European flat oyster itself but also on the reef and its associated biodiversity.
body.zh: 欧洲扁平牡蛎（Ostrea edulis）曾经广泛分布，但现在在北海变得如此稀少，以至于不再形成具有生态功能的珊瑚礁。随着扁平牡蛎的消亡，为 100 多种海洋物种提供栖息地的三维结构也随之消失。因此，恢复不仅关注欧洲平牡蛎本身的回归，而且还关注珊瑚礁及其相关的生物多样性。

reflection.en: The decline of the European flat oyster in the North Sea, and the subsequent loss of habitat for over 100 marine species, reminds us of the intricate beauty and vulnerability of Yahweh's creation. Efforts to restore these reefs and their biodiversity reflect a deep human impulse to care for the world Yahweh declared 'very good' at its inception. It calls us...
reflection.zh: 北海欧洲扁平牡蛎数量的减少，以及随之而来的100多种海洋生物栖息地的丧失，提醒我们雅伟创造的精妙与脆弱。恢复这些牡蛎礁及其生物多样性的努力，反映了人类内心深处对雅伟起初宣告“甚好”的世界的关爱冲动。这呼唤我们参与到治愈和保护我们周围自然世界的行动中。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Musk's SpaceX to build $100bn launch site in Louisiana
title.zh: 马斯克旗下 SpaceX 将斥资 1000 亿美元在路易斯安那州建造发射场

summary.en: The project - named Starbase - will be the firm's biggest facility yet and aims to send rockets to space in 2029.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Multi-billionaire Elon Musk's rocket company SpaceX has announced that it will build its largest launch site yet in the southern US state of Louisiana.

Construction of the $100bn (£73bn) project - named Starbase - is due to start next year, with the 125,000-acre (50,585-hectare) site expanding on the company's operations beyond its current Texas headquarters and locations in Florida.

It will be used to "support thousands of Starship flights a year with missions launching to Earth orbit, the Moon, Mars and beyond," SpaceX said on Tuesday.

In June, SpaceX shares started trading on New York's technology-focused Nasdaq in the world's biggest ever stock market debut.

SpaceX said it aims to launch its first Starship flight from the new base in 2029.

The Louisiana facility will add more than 3,000 jobs to the region, the company said.

The Louisiana Economic Development agency said the average wage of workers at the base would be 192% more than the region's current mean salary.
body.zh: 亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克的火箭公司 SpaceX 宣布将在美国南部路易斯安那州建造迄今为止最大的发射场。 这个价值 1000 亿美元（730 亿英镑）的项目名为 Starbase，将于明年开始建设，占地 125,000 英亩（50,585 公顷）的场地将扩大该公司的业务范围，超越其目前的德克萨斯州总部和佛罗里达州的地点。 SpaceX 周二表示，它将用于“支持每年数千次星际飞船飞行，包括发射到地球轨道、月球、火星及其他地方的任务”。 6 月，SpaceX 股票开始在纽约科技股纳斯达克交易，这是全球有史以来规模最大的股票市场首次亮相。 SpaceX 表示，其目标是 2029 年从新基地发射首次 Starship 飞行。 该公司表示，路易斯安那州工厂将为该地区增加 3,000 多个就业岗位。 路易斯安那州经济发展机构表示，该基地工人的平均工资将比该地区目前的平均工资高出192%。

title.en: A nosy polar bear and a lucky squirrel: Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026 shortlist
title.zh: 好奇的北极熊和幸运的松鼠：2026年度野生动物摄影师入围名单

summary.en: The polar bear image taken by Audun Rikardsen was among the 'highly commended' entries in this year's competition.
summary.zh: Audun Rikardsen拍摄的北极熊照片入围了今年比赛的“高度赞扬”作品。

body.en:
How would it feel to find yourself face to face with one of the Arctic's most formidable predators?

This stunning image captures life from a seal's perspective. Taken by Norwegian wildlife photographer Audun Rikardsen, it was among the 'Highly Commended' entries in this year's Wildlife Photographer of the Year competition.

While working as a guide with Arctic Wildlife Tours, Rikardsen rigged an underwater camera with a motion sensor beneath a seal's breathing hole, and then waited. At 4am, a female polar bear approached and peered down.

Rikardsen then waited eight hours for the bear to move away before retrieving the camera and reviewing the images.

When he saw what he had captured, he said: "I was so extremely happy. I was screaming, so I probably woke up all the polar bears for miles."

Rikardsen has previously won two Wildlife Photographer of the Year categories: Birds in 2019 and Oceans: The Bigger Picture in 2025 .

The overall winners will be announced on Tuesday 13 October 2026, followed by an exhibition at the Natural History Museum in London , external from Friday 16 October 2026.

Crockford watched swifts return to London after their annual migration from Africa, filling the air with their high-pitched calls. Most flew too high to photograph, but a few lower-flying ones gave Crockford the opportunity to capture the picture he wanted.

Swifts spend almost their entire lives in the air, usually landing only to nest.

After rainfall, Miyazawa came across an Eastern Japanese toad making its way along a city street. He used a slow shutter speed to photograph it before it hopped back into the bushes.

Eastern Japanese toads are typically found in forests, grasslands and other terrestrial habitats across eastern Japan, but they have also proved remarkably adaptable to urban environments.

Aasen was flying a drone for the Norwegian Orca Survey when he noticed an adult orca carrying the body of a deceased calf through a Norwegian fjord.

The orca repeatedly allowed the calf to sink before bringing it back to the surface, a difficult moment to watch but one that Aasen felt was important to record.

The behaviour may have been an attempt to revive or protect the calf. Killer whales have previously been observed carrying deceased calves, including a case where a female Southern Resident killer whale carried her dead calf for at least 17 days.

A 2026 study , external suggests that this type of behaviour may be more widespread across the species than previously thought.

Only when they reviewed the images did the Grammatico twins realise they had captured a mosquito resting on the head of a fer-de-lance viper. They described it as "one of the most demanding focus stacks we've ever created".

body.zh: 与北极最强大的掠食者之一面对面，感觉如何？ 这张令人惊叹的照片从海豹的角度捕捉了生活。这张照片由挪威野生动物摄影师 Audun Rikardsen 拍摄，是今年年度野生动物摄影师大赛的“高度赞扬”作品之一。 在担任北极野生动物之旅的导游期间，里卡森在海豹的呼吸孔下方安装了一台带有运动传感器的水下摄像机，然后等待。凌晨 4 点，一只雌性北极熊走近并向下凝视。 里卡森随后等了八个小时，直到熊走开，然后才取回相机并查看图像。 当他看到自己捕捉到的东西时，他说：“我非常高兴。我在尖叫，所以我可能吵醒了几英里内的所有北极熊。” Rikardsen 此前曾荣获两​​项年度野生动物摄影师奖：2019 年的鸟类和 2025 年的海洋：更大的图景。 总获奖者将于 2026 年 10 月 13 日星期二公布，随后将于 2026 年 10 月 16 日星期五在伦敦自然历史博物馆举办展览。 克罗克福德看着雨燕从非洲一年一度的迁徙后返回伦敦，空气中充满了它们高亢的叫声。大多数飞机飞得太高而无法拍照，但少数飞得较低的飞机让克罗克福德有机会捕捉到他想要的照片。 雨燕几乎一生都在空中度过，通常只是为了筑巢而着陆。 雨后，宫泽在城市街道上发现了一只东日本蟾蜍。在它跳回灌木丛之前，他用慢速快门拍摄了它。 日本东部蟾蜍通常出现在日本东部的森林、草原和其他陆地栖息地，但事实证明它们对城市环境的适应能力也非常强。 奥森在为挪威逆戟鲸调查驾驶无人机时，注意到一头成年逆戟鲸携带着一头死去的小牛的尸体穿过挪威峡湾。 逆戟鲸多次让小牛沉入水中，然后将其带回水面，这是一个很难观看的时刻，但奥森认为记录下来很重要。 这种行为可能是为了拯救或保护小牛。此前曾观察到虎鲸携带死去的小鲸鱼，其中一头雌性南方常驻虎鲸携带死去的小鲸鱼至少 17 天。 一项 2026 年的研究表明，这种行为在整个物种中可能比之前想象的更为普遍。 只有当他们查看这些图像时，格拉玛提科双胞胎才意识到他们捕捉到了一只停在兰斯毒蛇头上的蚊子。他们将其描述为“我们创建的最苛刻的焦点堆栈之一”。 剧毒，可导致更多致命的蛇......

summary.en: Intelligent people tend to perform better at school and at work, as numerous studies have shown. But what happens in domains where incentives such as good grades or financial rewards don't apply and where socioeconomic status is not a significant factor? Wine knowledge is a case...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Intelligent people tend to perform better at school and at work, as numerous studies have shown. But what happens in domains where incentives such as good grades or financial rewards don't apply and where socioeconomic status is not a significant factor? Wine knowledge is a case in point. Intelligence researcher Maximilian Krolo of Saarland University has investigated whether intelligence can predict the acquisition of deep knowledge in a specialized domain. The findings have now been published in the journal Intelligence & Cognitive Abilities in an article co-authored with Professor of Psychology Timothy C. Bates of the University of Edinburgh.
body.zh: 大量研究表明，聪明的人在学校和工作中往往表现更好。但是，在不适用好成绩或经济奖励等激励措施且社会经济地位不是重要因素的领域会发生什么？葡萄酒知识就是一个很好的例子。萨尔大学的情报研究员马克西米利安·克罗洛（Maximilian Krolo）研究了情报是否可以预测专业领域深层知识的获取。该研究结果现已发表在《智力与认知能力》杂志上，与爱丁堡大学心理学教授蒂莫西·贝茨 (Timothy C. Bates) 共同撰写了一篇文章。

title.en: Animation boosts willingness to adopt airborne disease precautions, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现动画提高了采取空气传播疾病预防措施的意愿

summary.en: Even as the scientific community has reached a broad consensus that infectious pathogens, such as viruses, can spread through virus-laden aerosols, one fundamental challenge remains: How can scientific evidence be transformed into public understanding—and ultimately into...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Even as the scientific community has reached a broad consensus that infectious pathogens, such as viruses, can spread through virus-laden aerosols, one fundamental challenge remains: How can scientific evidence be transformed into public understanding—and ultimately into meaningful action for effective airborne disease control and prevention?

A new international study led by researchers at the Aerosol Science Research Center, National Sun Yat-sen University (NSYSU), Taiwan, offers an evidence-based answer. Published in Humanities and Social Sciences Communications , the study demonstrates that animation is significantly more effective than text alone in motivating people to adopt preventive health behaviors.

The findings suggest that effective science communication is not simply about delivering accurate information. Rather, it is about helping people understand complex science, emotionally connect with its relevance and translate that understanding into action.

The interdisciplinary research team evaluated three science communication formats—plain text, explainer comics and animation—using "The Quest of the Virosols," an original educational series developed by the Aerosol Science Research Center team at NSYSU following publication of the team's review article in Science on airborne transmission of respiratory viruses .

The cross-national study involved 3,217 participants from Taiwan, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines, including health care professionals, educators and university students. Researchers examined how different communication formats influenced scientific understanding and willingness to adopt preventive measures against airborne infectious diseases.

While all three formats improved participants' knowledge, animation consistently produced the strongest behavioral impact. Compared with plain text, animation and explainer comics made complex concepts surrounding airborne virus transmission substantially easier to understand. Animation, however, went one step further—significantly increasing participants' willingness to implement preventive measures.

Professor Paichi Pat Shein, one of the study's corresponding authors, noted that animation's effectiveness lies not only in its visual appeal but also in its ability to create emotional engagement.

By combining narrative, imagery and character-driven storytelling, animation allows viewers to better understand how airborne diseases affect themselves, their families and society. This emotional connection strengthens risk perception, increases empathy and ultimately encourages behavioral change.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 尽管科学界已达成广泛共识，认为病毒等传染性病原体可以通过载有病毒的气溶胶传播，但仍然存在一个根本挑战：如何将科学证据转化为公众的理解，并最终转化为有效的空气传播疾病控制和预防的有意义的行动？ 由台湾国立中山大学 (NSYSU) 气溶胶科学研究中心的研究人员领导的一项新的国际研究提供了基于证据的答案。该研究发表在《人文与社会科学通讯》上，表明动画在激励人们采取预防性健康行为方面比单独的文本更有效。 研究结果表明，有效的科学传播不仅仅是提供准确的信息。相反，它是为了帮助人们理解复杂的科学，在情感上与其相关性建立联系，并将这种理解转化为行动。 跨学科研究小组使用“病毒的探索”评估了三种科学传播形式——纯文本、解释性漫画和动画——这是由新中山大学气溶胶科学研究中心团队在《科学》杂志上发表关于呼吸道病毒空气传播的评论文章后开发的原创教育系列。 这项跨国研究涉及来自台湾、印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾的 3,217 名参与者，其中包括医疗保健专业人员、教育工作者和大学生。研究人员研究了不同的沟通方式如何影响科学理解和采取预防措施预防空气传播传染病的意愿。 虽然这三种形式都提高了参与者的知识，但动画始终产生最强烈的行为影响。与纯文本相比，动画和解释漫画使有关空气传播病毒传播的复杂概念变得更容易理解。然而，动画更进一步——显着提高了参与者实施预防措施的意愿。 该研究的通讯作者之一 Paichi Pat Shein 教授指出，动画的有效性不仅在于其视觉吸引力，还在于其创造情感参与的能力。 通过结合叙事、图像和角色驱动的故事讲述，动画让观众更好地了解空气传播的疾病如何影响他们自己、家庭和社会。这种情感联系增强了风险感知，增加了同理心，并最终鼓励行为改变。 这...

body.en: ζ-Carotene, a key intermediate in lycopene biosynthesis, is widely found in plants and photosynthetic microorganisms, but its isomer-specific properties remain poorly understood due to isolation and purification challenges. Researchers have now developed a purification strategy to obtain high-purity geometric isomers and systematically characterized, for the first time, their isomer-specific spectral properties, photoisomerization behavior, UV-shielding capacity, antioxidant activity and skin-related biological activities—highlighting ζ-carotene's promise as a natural ingredient for skin health and photoprotection.
body.zh: δ-胡萝卜素是番茄红素生物合成的关键中间体，广泛存在于植物和光合微生物中，但由于分离和纯化方面的挑战，其异构体特异性特性仍然知之甚少。研究人员现已开发出一种纯化策略，以获得高纯度的几何异构体，并首次系统地表征了其异构体特定的光谱特性、光异构化行为、紫外线屏蔽能力、抗氧化活性和皮肤相关的生物活性，凸显了 z-胡萝卜素作为皮肤健康和光保护天然成分的前景。

title.en: A near extinct plant in Galápagos is now recovering

summary.en: A 30-year conservation effort has helped the critically endangered Galápagos snapdragon (Galvezia leucantha subsp. leucantha) recover from just six individuals to a small, carefully tended wild population. Following tireless conservation efforts and the planting of 94...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A 30-year conservation effort has helped the critically endangered Galápagos snapdragon (Galvezia leucantha subsp. leucantha) recover from just six individuals to a small, carefully tended wild population. Following tireless conservation efforts and the planting of 94 nursery-propagated plants that were reintroduced to Playa Tortuga Negra and Caleta Tagus, the wild adult population has grown from six individuals in 2007 to 28 healthy adults today—20 at Playa Tortuga Negra and 8 at Tagus Cove.
body.zh: 经过 30 年的保护工作，极度濒危的加拉帕戈斯金鱼草 (Galvezia leucantha subsp. leucantha) 从仅有 6 只个体恢复到经过精心照料的小型野生种群。经过不懈的保护工作，并种植了 94 种苗圃繁殖的植物，并将其重新引入 Playa Tortuga Negra 和 Caleta Tagus，野生成虫数量已从 2007 年的 6 只增加到如今的 28 只健康成虫，其中 Playa Tortuga Negra 20 只，Tagus 湾 8 只。

title.en: Yellow warnings in force as rain and thunderstorms hit parts of UK
title.zh: 英国部分地区遭遇降雨和雷暴天气，黄色预警生效

summary.en: Torrential downpours will affect parts of England and Wales, delivering some of the wettest weather in several weeks
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Downpours and thunderstorms will continue to bring the risk of flooding to parts of the UK on Wednesday.

A Met Office yellow warning for thunderstorms is valid from 03:00 until 22:00 BST, covering much of the Midlands, parts of northern, eastern and southern England, as well as the far east of Wales.

The rain could be heavy enough to bring flash flooding and travel disruption, with lightning and large hail posing additional hazards.

A further Met Office yellow warning has been issued for Thursday with more thunderstorms expected.

For some areas that have seen barely any rain so far this August, the next few days could bring the wettest weather in many weeks.

The Met Office yellow thunderstorm warning covers a large swathe of England and Wales.

A band of showers and thunderstorms will push northwards during Wednesday morning with sunny spells following from the south.

However, further scattered downpours and storms will spring up during the afternoon.

As many as 20-30mm (0.8-1.2in) of rain could fall in some locations within just an hour, and it is even possible that 40-50mm (1.6-2in) could accumulate over a few hours.

However, due to the hit-and-miss nature of showers, some places will miss the rain and weather apps may struggle to get the detail of the forecast correct.

Where the rain does fall, flash flooding is a real concern. This will be especially problematic where the ground is hard after the prolonged dry spell, making it difficult for the water to soak in.

Difficult driving conditions are expected with the chance that some roads could be closed.

Northern Ireland will also see some showers but these are likely to be less intense with less thunder.

Many parts of Scotland will remain dry with sunny spells, although some showers are likely in the south-west later.

Thursday will bring another zone of thunderstorms, again affecting mostly England and Wales.

The Met Office has issued a further yellow weather warning, valid from 06:00 until 22:00 BST.

Widespread rainfall totals of 20-30mm (0.8-1.2in) are expected in the warning area within three hours, while some areas could see 50mm (2in) within the same timeframe.

There is a small chance that eastern-facing hills - exposed to easterly winds - could record 75mm (3in) during 12 hours, which would bring a significant flood risk.

The showers may eventually reach southern Scotland and Northern Ireland but are likely to weaken and become less intense as they drift northwards.

Despite a period of unsettled weather last week, some southern parts of the UK have still seen barely any rain recently.

Brize Norton in Oxfordshire has recorded just 0.4mm of rain so far this August, less than 1% of what it would normally expect during the month as a whole.

body.zh: 周三，倾盆大雨和雷暴将继续给英国部分地区带来洪水风险。 英国气象局雷暴黄色预警的有效期为英国标准时间 03:00 至 22:00，覆盖中部地区的大部分地区、英格兰北部、东部和南部的部分地区以及威尔士远东地区。 降雨量可能大到足以引发山洪暴发和交通中断，闪电和大冰雹会造成额外的危险。 英国气象局周四再次发布黄色预警，预计会有更多雷暴天气。 对于一些今年八月迄今为止几乎没有下雨的地区来说，未来几天可能会出现数周以来最潮湿的天气。 英国气象局的雷暴黄色警报覆盖了英格兰和威尔士的大片地区。 周三上午，一阵阵阵阵雨和雷暴将向北推进，随后南方将迎来晴朗天气。 不过，下午还将有零星暴雨和暴风雨。 在短短一小时内，某些地方的降雨量可能会达到 20-30 毫米（0.8-1.2 英寸），甚至可能在几个小时内累积 40-50 毫米（1.6-2 英寸）。 然而，由于阵雨的偶然性，有些地方会错过降雨，天气应用程序可能很难获得正确的天气预报细节。 在下雨的地方，山洪暴发是一个真正令人担忧的问题。在长期干旱后地面坚硬，水难以渗透的情况下，这尤其成问题。 预计驾驶条件会很困难，部分道路可能会关闭。 北爱尔兰也将出现一些阵雨，但强度可能会减弱，雷声也较少。 苏格兰许多地区仍将保持干燥，并伴有晴朗天气，但西南部可能会出现阵雨。 周四将迎来另一个雷暴区，再次影响英格兰和威尔士。 英国气象局已发布进一步的黄色天气警报，有效期为英国夏令时间 06:00 至 22:00。 预计三小时内，预警区域的大范围降雨量将达到 20-30 毫米（0.8-1.2 英寸），而某些地区在同一时间内可能会出现 50 毫米（2 英寸）的降雨量。 面向东的山丘（暴露在东风中）有可能在 12 小时内记录 75 毫米（3 英寸）的降雨量，这将带来重大的洪水风险。 阵雨最终可能到达苏格兰南部和北爱尔兰，但随着向北漂移，阵雨可能会减弱并变得不那么强烈。 尽管上周天气不稳定，但英国南部一些地区最近仍然几乎没有下雨。 今年 8 月迄今为止，牛津郡的布里兹·诺顿 (Brize Norton) 的降雨量仅为 0.4 毫米，不到正常预期整个月降雨量的 1%。 这意味着我们期待着下雨......

body.en: Researchers at the University of St Andrews have gained unprecedented insight into marine mammal behavior when they become tangled in fishing nets. In a paper published Aug. 26 in Royal Society Open Science, researchers from the Sea Mammal Research Unit and Scottish Oceans Institute at St Andrews discovered that their passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) systems, deployed on a gill net, had unintentionally recorded a bycatch event. This is thought to be the first time this kind of recording has taken place in such detail.

title.en: Firms scramble for battery power in Spain and Portugal
title.zh: 西班牙和葡萄牙企业争夺电池动力

summary.en: After last year's massive power failure Spanish and Portuguese firms are buying battery back ups.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A massive power failure caused widespread chaos . People dug out lanterns and old radios, and companies scrambled to save what production they could.

The Spanish meat processing firm Fribin, in Binéfar, in the north eastern province of Aragon, was midway through its morning shift when the sudden shutdown brought production lines to a halt.

For Andrés Altabás, Fribin's technology and systems director, it was a nightmarish situation.

Emergency systems didn't have the capacity for continued operation. "Refrigeration was prioritised but all the lines had to be stopped," he adds.

Many tonnes of meat in the processing stage had to be discarded. "There were losses of hundreds of thousands of euros," says Altabás.

It was a big undertaking as the company's energy needs are "quite large", amounting to more than 25 gigawatt-hours a year, most of it for refrigeration.

The business had been considering investing in a battery back-up system for years, but it had been judged too expensive.

"And then came the blackout, and all of that together catalysed the investment," Altabás tells the BBC.

The first purchase of a five megawatt-hour module was made in June 2025, and a second module with the same storage capacity was ordered in early June 2026, both amounting to a total investment of around €1.5m (£1.3m; $1.7m), funded in part by the European Union's Next Generation funds.

Firms across Europe have been switching to electricity from fossil fuels for their industrial needs, encouraged by subsidies from EU funds.

While that is helping bring down emissions of climate-warming gases, it has also made firms more vulnerable to power cuts.

"The industrial sector has been one of the first to look at storage systems, since it can't have its production drop off too abruptly," says Miguel Matias, founder of the Portuguese energy services company Self Energy, headquartered in the UK.

"A backup for a few hours, or even minutes, might guarantee that machines don't get damaged," he says.

At the end of January, Storm Kristin toppled thousands of electricity and telecom poles across central Portugal, cutting power and communications to hundreds of thousands of people - some for weeks.

In Spain, battery storage capacity has risen almost sevenfold since last April, from about 28 MW before the blackout to 193MW in April 2026, according to the grid operator Red Eléctrica.

In December, the IDAE, Spain's Institute for the Diversification and Saving of Energy, awarded €827m in EU funds to 133 energy storage projects totalling 2,400MW. Around 80% of that is battery storage.

The new capacity will be close to 10 times the amount that Red Eléctrica currently registers on the Spanish grid.

body.zh: 大规模停电造成了大范围的混乱。人们挖出了灯笼和旧收音机，公司争先恐后地节省生产。 位于阿拉贡东北部比内法尔的西班牙肉类加工公司弗里宾（Fribin）正在早班中途，突然停工导致生产线停顿。 对于弗里宾的技术和系统总监安德烈斯·阿尔塔巴斯来说，这是一个噩梦般的情况。 应急系统没有持续运行的能力。 “制冷是优先考虑的，但所有生产线都必须停止，”他补充道。 许多吨在加工阶段的肉类不得不被丢弃。 “损失达数十万欧元，”阿尔塔巴斯说。 这是一项艰巨的任务，因为该公司的能源需求“相当大”，每年超过 25 吉瓦时，其中大部分用于制冷。 该公司多年来一直在考虑投资电池备份系统，但被认为过于昂贵。 “然后停电了，所有这些共同促进了投资，”阿尔塔巴斯告诉英国广播公司。 首次购买的 5 兆瓦时模块于 2025 年 6 月进行，第二个具有相同存储容量的模块于 2026 年 6 月上旬订购，两者总投资约为 150 万欧元（130 万英镑；170 万美元），部分资金由欧盟下一代基金提供。 在欧盟基金补贴的鼓励下，欧洲各地的企业一直在转向使用化石燃料发电来满足其工业需求。 虽然这有助于减少气候变暖气体的排放，但也使企业更容易受到断电的影响。 总部位于英国的葡萄牙能源服务公司 Self Energy 的创始人米格尔·马蒂亚斯 (Miguel Matias) 表示：“工业部门是最先关注存储系统的部门之一，因为它的产量不能突然下降。” “备份几个小时，甚至几分钟，可能会保证机器不会损坏，”他说。 一月底，克里斯汀风暴摧毁了葡萄牙中部数千根电线杆和电信杆，导致数十万人断电和通讯，有些人的供电和通讯中断了数周。 据电网运营商 Red Eléctrica 称，自去年 4 月以来，西班牙的电池存储容量已增加近七倍，从停电前的约 28 兆瓦增加到 2026 年 4 月的 193 兆瓦。 去年12月，西班牙能源多元化和节能研究所IDAE向133个储能项目提供了8.27亿欧元的欧盟资金，总装机容量为2,400MW。其中约 80% 是电池存储。 新容量将接近 Red Eléctrica 目前在西班牙电网注册容量的 10 倍。 “我们不仅看到需求的增长，而且还看到客户的明显演变......

title.en: Does 'rewilded' land need better wildfire prevention measures?
title.zh: “荒野”土地是否需要更好的野火预防措施？

summary.en: RSPB is considering measures it can take to improve resilience in the wake of a five week long fire
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As we're driving in a pickup truck to see the aftermath of a huge fire which burnt for more than a month in the Cairngorms, I spot fresh smoke coming from the ground.

My guide - RSPB Scotland's site manager at the Abernethy nature reserve, Ben Oliver-Jones - puts the vehicle in reverse and we jump out to see what's happening.

It's one of several hot-spots which keeps emerging a full week after firefighters left the scene , which Ben likens to a game of whack-a-mole in an already charred landscape where the smell of burning still hangs heavily in the air.

But while the small pockets of smouldering vegetation are still being dealt with, attention is turning to improving wildfire protection.

More than 2,500 hectares of moorland and forest - about 10 square miles - was destroyed in the fire, which led to the evacuation of an entire village and where the smoke could be seen and smelt 60 miles (96.5km) away in Aberdeen.

Like a growing number of Scotland's estates, the Loch Garten and Abernethy nature reserve is being managed for ecological restoration - what others might describe as 'rewilding', a now polarising term which the RSPB avoids using.

Opponents have argued that the process leaves areas more vulnerable to uncontrollable fires, which the charity disputes, but it has identified significant land management changes it plans to make.

The changes focus on four key areas: fire breaks, wetlands, heather management and tree planting.

While the estate's network of tracks functioned as a fire break in some locations, in other areas strong winds helped high flames jump the gap.

Experts say fire from burning heather can reach heights of six metres and that fire breaks need to be three times the flame height.

RSPB Scotland says it now acknowledges that fire breaks need to be wider and has already started that process on its long network of forest trails.

Machines have been used to remove vegetation on either side of the track with the hope that what remains would not create such high flames if it were to ignite.

While it might look desolate now, the hope is that some insects and plant species will eventually colonise the ground either sides of the tracks.

It also plans to create more ponds and wet areas around the site which can be used as a source of water to pump onto fires.

A small fire on the reserve in June was extinguished using water from a pond created with cash from the Scottish government's nature restoration fund as a habitat for species like rare dragonflies.

The charity says it's working to raise water tables where bogs have been drained and create new areas of standing water for fire fighting.

body.zh: 当我们开着一辆皮卡车去看凯恩戈姆一场大火烧了一个多月的余波时，我发现地面冒出新鲜的烟雾。 我的导游——皇家鸟类保护协会苏格兰阿伯内西自然保护区的现场经理本·奥利弗-琼斯——让车辆倒车，我们跳下车去看发生了什么。 这是消防员离开现场整整一周后不断出现的几个热点之一，本将其比作在已经烧焦的土地上进行的打地鼠游戏，空气中仍然弥漫着烧焦的气味。 不过，虽然仍在处理小片阴燃植被，但人们的注意力正在转向改善野火防护。 超过 2,500 公顷的沼泽地和森林（约 10 平方英里）在大火中被毁，导致整个村庄被疏散，在 60 英里（96.5 公里）外的阿伯丁也能看到并闻到浓烟。 与越来越多的苏格兰庄园一样，加滕湖和阿伯内西自然保护区也正在进行生态恢复管理——其他人可能将其描述为“野化”，这是一个现在两极分化的术语，皇家鸟类保护协会避免使用这个术语。 反对者认为，这一过程使地区更容易遭受无法控制的火灾，慈善机构对此提出了异议，但它已经确定了计划进行的重大土地管理改革。 这些变化集中在四个关键领域：防火带、湿地、石南花管理和植树。 虽然庄园的轨道网络在某些地方起到了防火带的作用，但在其他地区，强风帮助大火跳过了缺口。 专家表示，燃烧石南花的火可以达到六米的高度，火势需要是火焰高度的三倍。 苏格兰皇家鸟类保护协会表示，它现在承认防火带需要更宽，并且已经在其漫长的森林步道网络上开始了这一进程。 机器已被用来清除轨道两侧的植被，希望剩下的植物在点燃时不会产生如此高的火焰。 虽然现在看起来很荒凉，但希望一些昆虫和植物物种最终能够在铁轨两侧的地面上定居。 它还计划在现场周围建造更多的池塘和潮湿区域，可用作消防水源。 六月保护区发生的一场小火被扑灭，水来自一个池塘，该池塘是用苏格兰政府自然恢复基金的资金建造的，作为稀有蜻蜓等物种的栖息地。 该慈善机构表示，正在努力提高已排干沼泽的地下水位，并开辟新的积水区域用于消防。 事实证明，泥炭地容易引发野火，因为火可以通过泥炭、地下深处以及地面蔓延。

title.en: Shingles vaccine linked to 24% lower dementia risk
title.zh: 带状疱疹疫苗与痴呆症风险降低24%相关

summary.en: Older adults who received the Shingrix shingles vaccine were 24% less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over four years in a study of more than 500,000 people. Researchers estimate the difference could amount to roughly one dementia case prevented for every 17 people, suggesting a significant secondary benefit to...
summary.zh: 一项针对超过50万人的研究显示，接种Shingrix带状疱疹疫苗的老年人在四年内被诊断出患有痴呆症的可能性降低了24%。研究人员估计，每17名接种疫苗的人中就可能减少一例痴呆症病例，这表明该疫苗具有显著的额外健康益处。

body.en:
Older adults who received a shingles vaccine after entering a skilled nursing facility were less likely to be diagnosed with dementia over the following four years, according to a new study. Researchers found that vaccinated adults had a 24% lower risk of dementia compared with those who did not receive the vaccine.

The analysis drew on Medicare data and health records from more than 500,000 adults age 66 and older who were admitted to skilled nursing facilities for either short-term or long-term care. Researchers compared patients who received at least one dose of the recombinant shingles vaccine, known as RZV or Shingrix, with patients who remained unvaccinated. Shingrix was introduced in 2017 and is currently the only shingles vaccine available on the market.

"A lot of previous studies with similar results focused on an older vaccine," said study author Kaley Hayes, an assistant professor at Brown University's School of Public Health. "This study looks at the newest vaccine only in an older, vulnerable adult population who were not up to date with shingles vaccination and are at a very clear clinical point in care: entering a skilled nursing facility."

The results are consistent with several earlier studies involving a previous shingles vaccine that also found an association between shingles vaccination and a reduced risk of dementia.

"It fits into this large puzzle that's just starting to come together that the vaccines are effective at preventing shingles and also appear to have neuroprotective benefits as well," said Hayes, who is also the associate director of pharmacoepidemiology for Brown's Center for Gerontology and Healthcare Research.

Hayes led the study, published in Annals of Internal Medicine , with researchers from Brown, the University of Delaware, the Providence Veterans Affairs Medical Center and other institutions.

The researchers used a technique called target trial emulation to analyze the data. This approach attempts to recreate some of the conditions of a randomized clinical trial in situations where conducting such a trial is not practical.

The study included Medicare claims and electronic health records from patients admitted to more than 5,500 skilled nursing facilities nationwide between 2017 and 2022. Of the 509,926 people included in the analysis, just 8,843 received the shingles vaccine.

Participants had to be eligible for shingles vaccination and could not have previously been diagnosed with dementia.

After four years of follow-up, adults who had received at least one of the two Shingrix doses were substantially less likely to receive a dementia diagnosis. Dementia developed in 18.8% of vaccinated participants, compared with 24.6% of those who were not vaccinated.

title.en: Atomic catalyst unlocks the hidden value of plant waste
title.zh: 原子催化剂释放植物废料的隐藏价值

summary.en: Scientists have developed a highly efficient catalyst that breaks down lignin, a tough component of plant waste, into useful chemicals under mild conditions. By understanding the catalyst's atomic-level function, this discovery could advance sustainable manufacturing using agricultural and forestry byproducts.
summary.zh: 科学家们开发出一种高效催化剂，能在相对温和的条件下将植物废料中坚韧的木质素分解成有用的化学物质。通过了解该催化剂的原子级功能，这项发现有望推动利用林业和农业副产品实现可持续制造。

body.en:
Lignin gives plants much of their structural strength and represents the largest renewable source of aromatic chemicals found in nature. It can make up a substantial share (up to 35%) of waste biomass from agriculture and forestry. Yet lignin's complicated molecular structure makes it notoriously difficult to break apart efficiently, which has limited its potential use in sustainable manufacturing.

In a study published in ACS Catalysis , an international team that included Dr. Christopher Parlett, Xinyue Zhou, and Yutao Jiang from the Department of Chemical Engineering developed a highly efficient "single-atom catalyst." The researchers also determined, at the molecular level, how the catalyst breaks the strong chemical bonds that help hold lignin together.

The catalyst contains individual ruthenium atoms embedded within a nitrogen-doped carbon material. By keeping the ruthenium atoms isolated, the design can deliver strong catalytic performance while requiring only very small amounts of metal, improving efficiency compared with conventional systems.

One persistent obstacle in lignin research has been identifying exactly which parts of a catalyst are responsible for breaking the material's unusually strong chemical bonds. Without that information, researchers have had limited guidance for designing more effective catalysts.

The team found that a particular atomic arrangement known as a "Ru-N 4 site" is especially important. These sites activate oxygen molecules and help trigger the breaking of both carbon-oxygen and carbon-carbon bonds within lignin.

Using a combination of laboratory experiments and computational modeling, the researchers were able to reconstruct the process in greater detail. The catalyst first activates oxygen, producing highly reactive species. Those species then attack the lignin structure and split it into smaller molecules.

When tested under optimized conditions, the catalyst converted nearly all of the model lignin compounds and generated high yields of valuable chemical products, including phenol.

The process also works under relatively mild conditions and does not require harsh chemicals. That combination could make the approach useful for developing more sustainable methods of chemical manufacturing.

The researchers went beyond simplified model compounds and tested the catalyst on real lignin collected from several biomass sources. It successfully converted those samples into useful aromatic compounds that could potentially become building blocks for fuels, plastics, and other materials.

The findings provide a more detailed picture of how single-atom catalysts operate during biomass conversion. That understanding could serve as a guide for developing more efficient catalytic systems in the future.

body.zh: 木质素赋予植物很大的结构强度，是自然界中发现的最大的可再生芳香族化学品来源。它可以占农业和林业废弃生物质的很大一部分（高达 35%）。然而，木质素复杂的分子结构使其很难有效分解，这限制了其在可持续制造中的潜在用途。 在《ACS Catalysis》上发表的一项研究中，化学工程系的 Christopher Parlett 博士、Xinyue Zhou 和 Yutao Jiang 等国际团队开发了一种高效的“单原子催化剂”。研究人员还在分子水平上确定了催化剂如何破坏有助于将木质素结合在一起的强化学键。 该催化剂含有嵌入氮掺杂碳材料中的单个钌原子。通过保持钌原子隔离，该设计可以提供强大的催化性能，同时仅需要极少量的金属，与传统系统相比提高了效率。 木质素研究中一个持续存在的障碍是准确识别催化剂的哪些部分负责破坏材料异常坚固的化学键。如果没有这些信息，研究人员在设计更有效的催化剂方面获得的指导就很有限。 研究小组发现，一种被称为“Ru-N 4 位点”的特殊原子排列尤其重要。这些位点激活氧分子并有助于触发木质素内碳-氧和碳-碳键的断裂。 通过结合实验室实验和计算模型，研究人员能够更详细地重建该过程。催化剂首先活化氧气，产生高活性物质。然后这些物质攻击木质素结构并将其分裂成更小的分子。 在优化条件下进行测试时，该催化剂转化了几乎所有的模型木质素化合物，并产生了高产率的有价值的化学产品，包括苯酚。 该过程还可以在相对温和的条件下进行，并且不需要刺激性化学品。这种结合可以使该方法有助于开发更可持续的化学制造方法。 研究人员超越了简化的模型化合物，并在从几种生物质来源收集的真实木质素上测试了催化剂。它成功地将这些样品转化为有用的芳香族化合物，这些化合物有可能成为燃料、塑料和其他材料的基础材料。 这些发现提供了单原子催化剂在生物质转化过程中如何运作的更详细信息。这种理解可以作为未来开发更高效催化系统的指南。 “理解...

Yet, through patient observation and scientific inquiry, researchers have unlocked its potential. This reminds us that Yahweh's creation is full of hidden wisdom, waiting to be discovered by those who diligently seek to understand it.

title.en: Scientists find hidden “highways” guiding animal evolution
title.zh: 科学家发现指导动物进化的隐藏“高速公路”

summary.en: A sweeping analysis of thousands of animal genomes suggests that chromosomes do not evolve randomly but instead follow a limited number of irreversible “evolutionary highways.” These one-way genetic changes preserve clues to more than 600 million years of animal history and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A human, an octopus, and a coral may appear to have almost nothing in common, but their chromosomes still contain recognizable fragments inherited from an animal ancestor that lived more than 600 million years ago. Researchers at the University of Vienna have now traced how those ancient genomic pieces were reorganized as animal life diversified.

The study, published in Science Advances , suggests that animal genomes do not evolve through an unlimited number of possible routes. Instead, chromosome changes tend to move along a restricted set of irreversible pathways that the researchers describe as "evolutionary highways." The findings may also provide a valuable foundation for efforts to understand and conserve animal biodiversity.

Every living animal ultimately descends from a common ancestor that existed more than 600 million years ago. Since that time, chromosomes have repeatedly fused, separated, and been rearranged as new animal lineages emerged.

Thousands of animal genomes have now been sequenced, but comparing their long-term evolution has remained difficult. In this study, an international team led by University of Vienna researchers brought thousands of genomes together in a single large-scale comparison.

"Understanding these rules of evolution doesn't just tell us about the past," said Oleg Simakov, a professor at the University of Vienna who co-led the study. "It also lets us ask where genome evolution might go next and enables us to identify key measures for the conservation of animal biodiversity."

Many sequenced genomes remain "drafts." They can reveal which genes an animal possesses without showing exactly where those genes are positioned along its chromosomes. Chromosome-scale assemblies provide much more detail by arranging genes in their proper order across complete chromosomes. Producing these assemblies is considerably more difficult, and only recently have enough species been analyzed at this level to make a broad comparison across the animal kingdom possible.

The researchers examined more than 5,800 publicly available chromosome-scale genomes representing 4,454 species from 19 animal phyla. According to the team, this is the largest comparison of its kind across the animal tree of life.

To organize such a vast amount of information, the scientists created a framework called evolutionary genome topology. It places the enormous variety of animal genome structures onto a single map.

That map revealed an important pattern. Genome architecture does not appear to change randomly. Instead, animal lineages tend to move along "evolutionary highways." Evidence from hundreds of living species shows that different groups traveled along these routes or departed from them at different times and at different rates.

body.zh: 人类、章鱼和珊瑚可能看起来几乎没有任何共同点，但它们的染色体仍然包含从生活在 6 亿多年前的动物祖先那里遗传下来的可识别片段。维也纳大学的研究人员现在已经追踪到这些古老的基因组片段是如何随着动物生命的多样化而重组的。 这项发表在《科学进展》上的研究表明，动物基因组不会通过无限数量的可能途径进化。相反，染色体变化往往沿着一组有限的不可逆转的路径移动，研究人员将其称为“进化高速公路”。这些发现还可能为了解和保护动物生物多样性的努力提供宝贵的基础。 每一种现存的动物最终都源自六亿多年前存在的共同祖先。从那时起，随着新的动物谱系的出现，染色体不断地融合、分离和重新排列。 数千个动物基因组现已被测序，但比较它们的长期进化仍然很困难。在这项研究中，由维也纳大学研究人员领导的国际团队将数千个基因组放在一起进行了一次大规模比较。 “了解这些进化规则不仅仅告诉我们过去的情况，”共同领导这项研究的维也纳大学教授奥列格·西马科夫说。 “它还让我们了解基因组进化下一步可能走向何方，并使我们能够确定保护动物生物多样性的关键措施。” 许多测序的基因组仍然是“草稿”。他们可以揭示动物拥有哪些基因，而无需准确显示这些基因在其染色体上的位置。染色体规模的组装通过在完整染色体上按正确的顺序排列基因来提供更多细节。生产这些组件要困难得多，直到最近才在这个水平上分析了足够多的物种，以便在整个动物界进行广泛的比较。 研究人员检查了超过 5,800 个公开的染色体规模基因组，代表 19 个动物门的 4,454 个物种。据该团队称，这是动物生命树中同类中规模最大的比较。 为了组织如此大量的信息，科学家们创建了一个称为进化基因组拓扑的框架。它将种类繁多的动物基因组结构放在一张图上。 那张地图揭示了一个重要的模式。基因组结构似乎并不是随机变化的。相反，动物谱系往往沿着“进化高速公路”移动。来自数百个现存物种的证据表明，不同的群体沿着这些路线旅行或在不同的时间和以不同的速度离开这些路线。 “对于第一次...

title.en: NASA finds Earth microbes could survive on the Moon
title.zh: 美国宇航局发现地球微生物可以在月球上生存

summary.en: NASA scientists found that microbes brought by astronauts could survive in cold, shadowed niches around the Moon’s South Pole, potentially complicating future searches for pristine lunar chemistry. Some refuges may be no larger than a footprint, while one hardy fungus could even...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
NASA scientists say some microbes carried into space by human explorers may be able to survive in sheltered, shadowed areas near the Moon's South Pole.

The findings, published on Aug. 19, 2026, in Science Advances , underscore the importance of understanding how long Earth microbes can persist in extreme lunar environments. As people establish a more permanent presence on the Moon, contamination from astronauts could make it harder for scientists to separate ancient lunar chemistry from material introduced by humans. Researchers say the same issue will matter when missions eventually search for signs of life on Mars.

"Humans are natural explorers, and with them come their voices, their memories … and their microbes," said Prabal Saxena, a planetary scientist who led the study from NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland. "For some scientists, myself included, that reality can be unsettling. But it also creates an opportunity to turn an imperfect situation into a useful experiment."

Humans inevitably carry microbes with them. On average, about 1 million bacteria live on every patch of skin roughly the size of a pencil eraser. Some of these organisms can escape from spacesuits and habitats into the surrounding environment.

That creates a challenge for scientists hoping to study chemical evidence connected to the Moon's ancient geology or possible biology. At the same time, the researchers argue that the Moon could serve as a valuable natural laboratory. Carefully monitored shadowed regions near the South Pole could allow scientists to test the real limits of microbial survival under conditions that are extremely difficult to reproduce on Earth.

Before those experiments can begin, however, researchers need to establish a clear baseline showing what contaminants humans introduce.

"We need to understand what was there before us, because when we go to Mars to search for signs of life beyond our planet, we will want to make sure it's not stuff we brought," said Andrew Needham, a NASA Goddard-based paper co-author who is an Artemis contamination-control scientist for lunar samples.

Even rigorous sterilization cannot eliminate every hardy organism. One example is Aspergillus niger , a fungus that commonly grows in warm, humid environments such as bathrooms and heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems.

Astronauts have collected samples of the fungus aboard the International Space Station, and previous experiments have shown that it can also survive outside the station. Aspergillus niger was one of five microbes examined in the new study because of its demonstrated resilience in spaceflight conditions.

Scientists were surprised that microbes like these could endure exposure on the exterior of the space station....
body.zh: 美国宇航局科学家表示，一些被人类探险家带入太空的微生物可能能够在月球南极附近受庇护的阴影区域生存。 该研究结果于 2026 年 8 月 19 日发表在《科学进展》杂志上，强调了了解地球微生物在月球极端环境中能够存活多久的重要性。随着人们在月球上建立更永久的存在，宇航员的污染可能会使科学家更难将古代月球化学物质与人类引入的物质分开。研究人员表示，当任务最终在火星上寻找生命迹象时，同样的问题也很重要。 “人类是天生的探险家，随之而来的是他们的声音、他们的记忆......以及他们的微生物，”领导这项研究的行星科学家普拉巴尔·萨克塞纳（Prabal Saxena）说，他来自马里兰州格林贝尔特的美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心。 “对于包括我在内的一些科学家来说，现实可能会令人不安。但它也创造了一个机会，可以将不完美的情况变成有用的实验。” 人类不可避免地携带微生物。平均而言，每一块橡皮大小的皮肤上都生活着大约 100 万个细菌。其中一些生物体可以从宇航服和栖息地逃逸到周围环境中。 这给希望研究与月球古代地质或可能的生物学有关的化学证据的科学家带来了挑战。与此同时，研究人员认为月球可以作为一个有价值的天然实验室。仔细监测南极附近的阴影区域可以让科学家测试微生物在地球上极难繁殖的条件下生存的真正极限。 然而，在这些实验开始之前，研究人员需要建立一个明确的基线，显示人类引入了哪些污染物。 “我们需要了解在我们之前存在的东西，因为当我们前往火星寻找地球以外的生命迹象时，我们需要确保它不是我们带来的东西，”美国宇航局戈达德论文合著者、月球样本阿耳忒弥斯污染控制科学家安德鲁·尼达姆(Andrew Needham)说。 即使严格的灭菌也不能消灭所有顽强的生物。一个例子是黑曲霉，这是一种通常生长在温暖、潮湿的环境中的真菌，例如浴室和供暖、通风和空调系统。 宇航员在国际空间站上收集了这种真菌的样本，之前的实验表明它也可以在空间站外生存。黑曲霉是这项新研究中检查的五种微生物之一，因为它在太空飞行条件下表现出恢复能力。 科学家们对这样的微生物能够忍受暴露在空间站外部感到惊讶......

title.en: Depression may shut down the brain’s ability to make new neurons
title.zh: 抑郁症可能会关闭大脑产生新神经元的能力

summary.en: A major study found that adults with depression show disrupted production of new neurons in the hippocampus, potentially weakening the brain’s ability to separate new experiences from painful memories. The researchers also identified broad molecular changes that could open the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Most of the brain's roughly 100 billion neurons are produced before birth. However, the small number of new neurons that continue to form in the adult hippocampus may play an important role in protecting against depression, according to new research from Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons.

The findings provide the first evidence that neurogenesis, the process of producing new neurons, stalls in the brains of adults with major depressive disorder. Researchers also identified molecular programs involved in controlling this process, offering potential clues for developing new treatments.

"Historically, depression was thought to be a disease of neurotransmitter deficiency, especially serotonin, but we now think that depression stems from multiple issues that affect our neurons' ability to adapt to stress and changing environments," says Maura Dupont, professor of psychiatry, who led the research.

"Without the ability to create new neurons, people with depression may not have the resilience to effectively adapt to the environment."

The researchers focused on the hippocampus, a brain region that plays a major role in episodic memory and emotional responses to the environment. It is also one of the few areas of the adult brain that continues to generate new neurons.

Although the hippocampus is not the only brain region involved in depression, its influence over both memory and emotion has made it an important area of study. Researchers believe changes there may contribute to the tendency of people with depression to interpret experiences more negatively.

"The hippocampus is important for our ability to distinguish between similar but different memories and separate the emotional connotation of past memories and current events," Dupont says.

This ability is known as pattern separation. When it becomes impaired, individual memories and the emotions attached to them may become less distinct, allowing separate experiences to blend together.

"You may be out with a friend for lunch, but she's tired and doesn't talk much. With intact pattern separation, you remember this as a unique event. With impaired pattern separation, it becomes mixed with previous memories of feeling rejected, leading you to think, 'They're upset with me'," Dupont explains. "And I see this a lot in my patients, where they can only retrieve negative information from their memories."

Research in mice has shown that adult neurogenesis is necessary for pattern separation. A recent study involving patients with brain tumors, in whom neurogenesis was eliminated by radiation therapy directed at the hippocampus, suggests that the same relationship may exist in humans.

title.en: Musk's SpaceX to build $100bn launch site in Louisiana
title.zh: 马斯克旗下 SpaceX 将斥资 1000 亿美元在路易斯安那州建造发射场

summary.en: The project - named Starbase - will be the firm's biggest facility yet and aims to send rockets to space in 2029.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Multi-billionaire Elon Musk's rocket company SpaceX has announced that it will build its largest launch site yet in the southern US state of Louisiana.

Construction of the $100bn (£73bn) project - named Starbase - is due to start next year, with the 125,000-acre (50,585-hectare) site expanding on the company's operations beyond its current Texas headquarters and locations in Florida.

It will be used to "support thousands of Starship flights a year with missions launching to Earth orbit, the Moon, Mars and beyond," SpaceX said on Tuesday.

In June, SpaceX shares started trading on New York's technology-focused Nasdaq in the world's biggest ever stock market debut.

SpaceX said it aims to launch its first Starship flight from the new base in 2029.

The Louisiana facility will add more than 3,000 jobs to the region, the company said.

The Louisiana Economic Development agency said the average wage of workers at the base would be 192% more than the region's current mean salary.
body.zh: 亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克的火箭公司 SpaceX 宣布将在美国南部路易斯安那州建造迄今为止最大的发射场。 这个价值 1000 亿美元（730 亿英镑）的项目名为 Starbase，将于明年开始建设，占地 125,000 英亩（50,585 公顷）的场地将扩大该公司的业务范围，超越其目前的德克萨斯州总部和佛罗里达州的地点。 SpaceX 周二表示，它将用于“支持每年数千次星际飞船飞行，包括发射到地球轨道、月球、火星及其他地方的任务”。 6 月，SpaceX 股票开始在纽约科技股纳斯达克交易，这是全球有史以来规模最大的股票市场首次亮相。 SpaceX 表示，其目标是 2029 年从新基地发射首次 Starship 飞行。 该公司表示，路易斯安那州工厂将为该地区增加 3,000 多个就业岗位。 路易斯安那州经济发展机构表示，该基地工人的平均工资将比该地区目前的平均工资高出192%。

title.en: Firms scramble for battery power in Spain and Portugal
title.zh: 西班牙和葡萄牙企业争夺电池动力

summary.en: After last year's massive power failure Spanish and Portuguese firms are buying battery back ups.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A massive power failure caused widespread chaos . People dug out lanterns and old radios, and companies scrambled to save what production they could.

The Spanish meat processing firm Fribin, in Binéfar, in the north eastern province of Aragon, was midway through its morning shift when the sudden shutdown brought production lines to a halt.

For Andrés Altabás, Fribin's technology and systems director, it was a nightmarish situation.

Emergency systems didn't have the capacity for continued operation. "Refrigeration was prioritised but all the lines had to be stopped," he adds.

Many tonnes of meat in the processing stage had to be discarded. "There were losses of hundreds of thousands of euros," says Altabás.

It was a big undertaking as the company's energy needs are "quite large", amounting to more than 25 gigawatt-hours a year, most of it for refrigeration.

The business had been considering investing in a battery back-up system for years, but it had been judged too expensive.

"And then came the blackout, and all of that together catalysed the investment," Altabás tells the BBC.

The first purchase of a five megawatt-hour module was made in June 2025, and a second module with the same storage capacity was ordered in early June 2026, both amounting to a total investment of around €1.5m (£1.3m; $1.7m), funded in part by the European Union's Next Generation funds.

Firms across Europe have been switching to electricity from fossil fuels for their industrial needs, encouraged by subsidies from EU funds.

While that is helping bring down emissions of climate-warming gases, it has also made firms more vulnerable to power cuts.

"The industrial sector has been one of the first to look at storage systems, since it can't have its production drop off too abruptly," says Miguel Matias, founder of the Portuguese energy services company Self Energy, headquartered in the UK.

"A backup for a few hours, or even minutes, might guarantee that machines don't get damaged," he says.

At the end of January, Storm Kristin toppled thousands of electricity and telecom poles across central Portugal, cutting power and communications to hundreds of thousands of people - some for weeks.

In Spain, battery storage capacity has risen almost sevenfold since last April, from about 28 MW before the blackout to 193MW in April 2026, according to the grid operator Red Eléctrica.

In December, the IDAE, Spain's Institute for the Diversification and Saving of Energy, awarded €827m in EU funds to 133 energy storage projects totalling 2,400MW. Around 80% of that is battery storage.

The new capacity will be close to 10 times the amount that Red Eléctrica currently registers on the Spanish grid.

body.zh: 大规模停电造成了大范围的混乱。人们挖出了灯笼和旧收音机，公司争先恐后地节省生产。 位于阿拉贡东北部比内法尔的西班牙肉类加工公司弗里宾（Fribin）正在早班中途，突然停工导致生产线停顿。 对于弗里宾的技术和系统总监安德烈斯·阿尔塔巴斯来说，这是一个噩梦般的情况。 应急系统没有持续运行的能力。 “制冷是优先考虑的，但所有生产线都必须停止，”他补充道。 许多吨在加工阶段的肉类不得不被丢弃。 “损失达数十万欧元，”阿尔塔巴斯说。 这是一项艰巨的任务，因为该公司的能源需求“相当大”，每年超过 25 吉瓦时，其中大部分用于制冷。 该公司多年来一直在考虑投资电池备份系统，但被认为过于昂贵。 “然后停电了，所有这些共同促进了投资，”阿尔塔巴斯告诉英国广播公司。 首次购买的 5 兆瓦时模块于 2025 年 6 月进行，第二个具有相同存储容量的模块于 2026 年 6 月上旬订购，两者总投资约为 150 万欧元（130 万英镑；170 万美元），部分资金由欧盟下一代基金提供。 在欧盟基金补贴的鼓励下，欧洲各地的企业一直在转向使用化石燃料发电来满足其工业需求。 虽然这有助于减少气候变暖气体的排放，但也使企业更容易受到断电的影响。 总部位于英国的葡萄牙能源服务公司 Self Energy 的创始人米格尔·马蒂亚斯 (Miguel Matias) 表示：“工业部门是最先关注存储系统的部门之一，因为它的产量不能突然下降。” “备份几个小时，甚至几分钟，可能会保证机器不会损坏，”他说。 一月底，克里斯汀风暴摧毁了葡萄牙中部数千根电线杆和电信杆，导致数十万人断电和通讯，有些人的供电和通讯中断了数周。 据电网运营商 Red Eléctrica 称，自去年 4 月以来，西班牙的电池存储容量已增加近七倍，从停电前的约 28 兆瓦增加到 2026 年 4 月的 193 兆瓦。 去年12月，西班牙能源多元化和节能研究所IDAE向133个储能项目提供了8.27亿欧元的欧盟资金，总装机容量为2,400MW。其中约 80% 是电池存储。 新容量将接近 Red Eléctrica 目前在西班牙电网注册容量的 10 倍。 “我们不仅看到需求的增长，而且还看到客户的明显演变......

title.en: The world's busiest spaceport is about to get a lot quieter, at least for now
title.zh: 世界上最繁忙的太空港即将变得安静得多，至少目前如此

summary.en: SpaceX aims to launch Starship from Florida by the end of the year. 2027 seems more likely.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: SpaceX made Florida's Space Coast home to the world's busiest spaceport for a decade, but that will change this year. The company is significantly cutting the number of launches from Florida until Starship arrives, a senior SpaceX official confirmed Tuesday. The Falcon 9 rocket has been SpaceX's workhorse, routinely launching batches of satellites for the company's Starlink network, primarily from launch pads at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station and NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. There were 165 Falcon 9 launches last year—about three flights per week—and about 75 percent of them carried Starlink satellites. This year is different. SpaceX has launched more missions from its West Coast launch pad at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California since January, and this trend will amplify for the rest of the year. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 十年来，SpaceX 使佛罗里达州太空海岸成为世界上最繁忙的太空港，但今年情况将发生改变。 SpaceX 的一位高级官员周二证实，该公司将大幅削减在 Starship 抵达之前从佛罗里达州出发的发射次数。猎鹰 9 号火箭一直是 SpaceX 的主力，定期为该公司的星链网络发射批量卫星，主要是从卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站和美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的发射台发射。去年猎鹰 9 号发射了 165 次——大约每周 3 次——其中约 75% 携带星链卫星。今年有所不同。自 1 月份以来，SpaceX 从位于加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地的西海岸发射台发射了更多任务，这一趋势将在今年剩余时间内加剧。阅读全文 评论

title.en: World humanoid robot games show runners breaking records, bursting into flames
title.zh: 世界人形机器人比赛展示跑步者打破记录并爆发火焰

summary.en: Record-breaking robot races are less substantial than household chore challenges.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Viral videos of the World Humanoid Robot Games show sprinting robots beating the human 100-meter record held by Usain Bolt—but also feature running robots crashing into barriers and falling down because they cannot readily stop running. A few fallen robots even break at the waist in a shower of sparks or catch on fire. That demonstration of both robotic prowess and limitations came from the second edition of the World Humanoid Robot Games hosted in Beijing from August 22–26. Like the inaugural event held in 2025, this year’s event challenged humanoid robots to run fast, perform kung fu or dance moves, fight one another in kickboxing, and play soccer or table tennis. This year’s games also tested robots in more humdrum practical scenarios like washing and hanging laundry, where they appeared to lag behind typical human working speeds. That suggests the event organizers, including Chinese state media and the Beijing city government, are keen to showcase the commercial potential of humanoid robots at a time when China’s robotics industry is rapidly developing and testing such robots. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 世界人形机器人运动会的病毒视频显示，短跑机器人打破了尤塞恩·博尔特 (Usain Bolt) 保持的人类 100 米纪录，但也有跑步机器人因无法轻易停止奔跑而撞上障碍物并摔倒的情况。一些坠落的机器人甚至在一阵火花中腰部折断或着火。 8 月 22 日至 26 日在北京举办的第二届世界人形机器人运动会展示了机器人的实力和局限性。与 2025 年举办的首届赛事一样，今年的赛事挑战人形机器人快速奔跑、表演功夫或舞蹈动作、踢拳击、踢足球或乒乓球。今年的比赛还在更单调的实际场景中测试了机器人，例如洗衣和晾衣服，它们似乎落后于人类的典型工作速度。这表明，在中国机器人行业正在快速开发和测试此类机器人之际，包括中国官方媒体和北京市政府在内的活动组织者热衷于展示人形机器人的商业潜力。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Preserving glow-in-the-dark art and fashion for future generations
title.zh: 为子孙后代保留夜光艺术和时尚

summary.en: Understanding unique photochemistry of such materials will help in conservation, storage, and exhibition.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Fashionistas of a certain age no doubt remember the late designer Stephen Sprouse , who gave Blondie's Debbie Harry her distinctive Bowery punk style. Sprouse's first collections in the mid-1980s made a major splash, melding graffiti prints, a playful '60s aesthetic, and bright Day-Glo colors that won admirers such as Andy Warhol. Several examples of Sprouse's work are preserved in the textiles collection of the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, where conservationists are trying to learn more about the phosphorescent and fluorescent pigments the designer used in his creations in order to keep the colors from dulling over time. They described recent advances in that research at a meeting of the American Chemical Society (ACS) held this week in Chicago. Scientists began describing minerals that glowed in the dark as phosphors in the Middle Ages. Typically, such materials take on a charge when exposed to light, storing the absorbed energy and releasing it gradually as re-emitted light. Henri Becquerel discovered radioactive decay in 1896 because of his work with phosphorescent uranium salts: He left the salts in a closed drawer with photographic plates, which fogged up even without a light source. DayGlo paints and similar materials exploit the related phenomenon of fluorescence. DayGlo pigments fluoresce in daylight by essentially converting UV light into visible light to produce brighter, more vibrant colors. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 某个年龄段的时尚达人无疑还记得已故设计师 Stephen Sprouse，他为 Blondie 的 Debbie Harry 赋予了独特的 Bowery 朋克风格。 Sprouse 在 20 世纪 80 年代中期推出的首个系列引起了巨大轰动，融合了涂鸦印花、俏皮的 60 年代美学以及明亮的 Day-Glo 色彩，赢得了安迪·沃霍尔 (Andy Warhol) 等崇拜者的青睐。纽菲尔德印第安纳波利斯艺术博物馆的纺织品收藏中保存了斯普罗斯作品的几个例子，那里的自然资源保护主义者正在尝试更多地了解设计师在他的创作中使用的磷光和荧光颜料，以防止颜色随着时间的推移而变暗。他们在本周于芝加哥举行的美国化学会 (ACS) 会议上描述了该研究的最新进展。中世纪时，科学家们开始将在黑暗中发光的矿物质描述为磷光体。通常，此类材料在暴露于光时会带电，存储吸收的能量并以重新发射的光的形式逐渐释放能量。 1896 年，亨利·贝克勒尔 (Henri Becquerel) 在研究磷光铀盐时发现了放射性衰变：他将盐放在一个装有照相底片的封闭抽屉中，即使没有光源，底片也会起雾。 DayGlo 涂料和类似材料利用了相关的荧光现象。 DayGlo 颜料在日光下发出荧光，本质上是将紫外线转化为可见光，从而产生更明亮、更鲜艳的颜色。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Google's anti-nausea Motion Assist dots finally rolling out on Android
title.zh: 谷歌的防晕动辅助点功能终于在安卓系统上推出

summary.en: Google's Motion Assist dots, designed to alleviate motion sickness by addressing the sensory mismatch between the inner ear and eyes, are now slowly rolling out on Android, currently appearing only on Pixels running Android 17.
summary.zh: 谷歌的防晕动辅助点功能旨在通过解决内耳和眼睛之间的感官不匹配来缓解晕动症，目前正在安卓系统上缓慢推出，仅在运行安卓17的Pixel手机上可见。

body.en: Some people are cursed with motion sickness, which can make it impossible to read or use a phone in a moving vehicle without suffering waves of nausea. There's a surprisingly simple trick that can make smartphones usable in such situations. Apple deployed it on the iPhone a couple of years ago, and now Google's own version is finally coming (slowly) to Android. Motion sickness is caused by a disagreement between what your inner ear senses and what your eyes see. If you're looking at a book or a screen while in a car, the sensory mismatch can lead to a pretty unpleasant time. As part of iOS 18 in 2024, Apple released a feature called Motion Cues that places a network of moving dots on the screen to alleviate motion sickness, and it seems to work surprisingly well. Google's version is similar, but it's called Motion Assist. Google began testing Motion Assist back in 2024, but it never expanded beyond an internal test until now. Android Authority reports Motion Assist is appearing on Pixel phones running Android 17, but there's no app or update you can install to get the feature—it's being delivered by Play Services as part of a staged rollout. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 有些人患有晕车症，在行驶的车辆中阅读或使用手机时会感到一阵阵恶心。有一个令人惊讶的简单技巧可以使智能手机在这种情况下可用。几年前，苹果公司在 iPhone 上部署了它，现在谷歌自己的版本终于（缓慢地）登陆 Android 了。晕动病是由于内耳感觉与眼睛看到的不一致引起的。如果你在车里看书或看屏幕，感官上的不匹配可能会导致一段非常不愉快的时光。作为 2024 年 iOS 18 的一部分，苹果发布了一项名为 Motion Cues 的功能，该功能在屏幕上放置移动点网络来缓解晕动病，而且效果似乎出奇的好。谷歌的版本类似，但它被称为Motion Assist。谷歌早在 2024 年就开始测试 Motion Assist，但直到现在才扩展到内部测试之外。 Android Authority 报告称，Motion Assist 出现在运行 Android 17 的 Pixel 手机上，但您无法安装任何应用程序或更新来获取该功能，该功能由 Play Services 作为分阶段推出的一部分提供。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Two unvaccinated people die from measles in Pennsylvania, officials confirm
title.zh: 官员证实，宾夕法尼亚州两名未接种疫苗的人死于麻疹

summary.en: "[P]eople are not familiar with this disease and don’t fully understand the potential severity."

body.en: Two unvaccinated people have died from measles in Pennsylvania, state health officials confirmed Tuesday . They are the first measles deaths reported in Pennsylvania in 35 years and the first deaths reported in the US in 2026. Last year, the US saw three measles deaths : two in otherwise-healthy but unvaccinated school-age children in Texas and one in an unvaccinated adult in New Mexico. Prior to those deaths, the US had not seen a measles death since 2015 , when a woman with underlying conditions became severely ill. Citing privacy, health officials in Pennsylvania are not providing information on the people who died beyond that they were unvaccinated and were residents of Lancaster County. Officials noted that the deaths are among 393 confirmed cases reported this year across 28 counties in the state. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员周二证实，宾夕法尼亚州有两名未接种疫苗的人死于麻疹。这是宾夕法尼亚州 35 年来首次报告的麻疹死亡病例，也是美国 2026 年报告的第一例麻疹死亡病例。去年，美国发生了 3 例麻疹死亡事件：德克萨斯州有 2 例健康但未接种疫苗的学龄儿童，新墨西哥州有 1 例未接种疫苗的成年人。在此之前，美国自 2015 年一名患有基础疾病的女性病情严重以来，就没有出现过麻疹死亡事件。宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员以隐私为由，没有提供有关死者的信息，除了未接种疫苗且是兰开斯特县居民的信息。官员们指出，今年该州 28 个县报告了 393 例确诊病例，其中包括这些死亡病例。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
title.zh: 澳大利亚音乐排行榜禁止人工智能创作的歌曲

summary.en: The move comes weeks after a DJ admitted using AI to remix a Madonna song that topped the Australian charts.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Songs that are largely or wholly created by AI have been banned from Australia's music charts.

The Australian Recording Industry Association (ARIA) said the new code would help "promote the human nature of artistry".

It follows a controversy around a cover of Madonna's Like A Prayer by Australian DJ Josh Fawaz which recently topped the ARIA dance singles chart and peaked at number 2 on the country's overall chart.

The song has become a staple of commercial radio station playlists and been streamed more than 48 million times on Spotify alone.

ARIA said that Australian artists were competing for attention "in the most crowded market in history" and that it was "not interested in promoting or celebrating the success of AI-generated music that does not contain human artistry".

Under the new rules, AI assistance can still be used, but humans must have written the song, and have performed the lead vocal and primary instruments.

AI can also still be used for mastering songs and, for example, using drum machines and auto tune.

Earlier this year a song was banned from Sweden's music charts because it was created by AI.

And in July, the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI) said AI guidelines would be rolled out in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia for use in their official charts.

The updated code, based on the IFPI directive, also excludes music that raises "stream or chart manipulation concerns".

ARIA chief executive Annabelle Herd said: "These changes reflect our intent to remain dynamic and promote the human nature of artistry in what is, to say the least, a rapidly developing space."

"Artists already use AI tools in their work, the charts can and should evolve to keep room for that, but music generated wholesale by services built on artists' recordings is a different matter."

She added: "A chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to represent."

Artists will be required to declare AI use when they submit a song for chart consideration.

ARIA said that if it later emerged music was largely AI-generated it could retrospectively adjust chart positions, and if the piece topped the charts, it may request that awards given for reaching Number One were returned.

Last month, they shared an AI-assisted version of their 2014 hit High on Instagram, captioned: "When you re-record your own song with AI so Australian radio will play it."

Band member Adam Hyde told Channel Nine's Today show that AI-generated music was "removing the human experience from life".

In July this year, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese promised "the strongest possible protection" from AI for Australian creatives.

body.zh: 大部分或完全由人工智能创作的歌曲已被禁止出现在澳大利亚音乐排行榜上。 澳大利亚唱片工业协会（ARIA）表示，新准则将有助于“促进艺术的人性化”。 此前，澳大利亚 DJ Josh Fawaz 翻唱了麦当娜的《Like A Prayer》引发争议，该歌曲最近登上了 ARIA 舞曲单曲榜榜首，并在该国总体排行榜上排名第二。 这首歌已成为商业广播电台播放列表的主要内容，仅在 Spotify 上的播放量就超过 4800 万次。 ARIA 表示，澳大利亚艺术家正在“在历史上最拥挤的市场”中争夺注意力，并且“对推广或庆祝不包含人类艺术性的人工智能生成音乐的成功不感兴趣”。 根据新规则，仍然可以使用人工智能辅助，但歌曲必须由人类创作，并演奏主唱和主要乐器。 人工智能仍然可以用于掌握歌曲，例如使用鼓机和自动调音。 今年早些时候，瑞典音乐排行榜禁止一首歌曲，因为它是由人工智能创作的。 7 月，国际唱片业联合会 (IFPI) 表示，人工智能指南将在拉丁美洲、中东、非洲和东南亚推出，用于其官方排行榜。 更新后的代码基于 IFPI 指令，还排除了引发“流媒体或图表操纵问题”的音乐。 ARIA 首席执行官安娜贝尔·赫德 (Annabelle Herd) 表示：“这些变化反映了我们在这个快速发展的领域保持活力并提升艺术人性的意图。” “艺术家已经在他们的工作中使用人工智能工具，图表可以而且应该不断发展以为此留出空间，但通过基于艺术家录音的服务批量生成的音乐是另一回事。” 她补充道：“奖励未经许可的人工智能输出的图表将削弱我们所代表的录制音乐的基础。” 艺术家在提交歌曲供排行榜考虑时将被要求声明人工智能的使用。 ARIA 表示，如果后来发现音乐主要是由人工智能生成的，它可以回顾性地调整排行榜位置，如果这首作品名列榜首，它可能会要求退回为达到第一名而颁发的奖项。 上个月，他们在 Instagram 上分享了 2014 年热门歌曲《High》的人工智能辅助版本，标题是：“当你用人工智能重新录制自己的歌曲时，澳大利亚电台就会播放它。” 乐队成员亚当·海德 (Adam Hyde) 在第九频道的《今日》节目中表示，人工智能生成的音乐正在“消除人类的生活体验”。 今年 7 月，澳大利亚总理 Anthony Albanese 承诺为澳大利亚创意人员提供“尽可能最强的保护”，使其免受人工智能的侵害。 阿尔巴尼斯承诺作家和音乐家将...
